distant motorcycles and muted market voices

glasses touching and awning cloth in sea wind

muted coffee stall voices and soft canvas movement

wind through wood joints and remote surf

rain on the awning and city traffic far away

wooden latch and distant morning traffic

FLOWER_BACK: Back room of Hạ flower shop, kettle and small wooden table, rear doorway toward main counter.
FLOWER_FRONT: Pavement directly outside Hạ flower shop, rolling shutter and warm street lamp, tower lobby beyond.

MARKET_REAR: Rear market exit toward a safe residential lane, no public crowd trapped inside.

MARKET_ROOF: Low market roof overlooking east and west harbour roads, landward apron and uphill lighthouse service path.

industrial pumps and footsteps on concrete

props.WATCH: ONE silver pocket watch, engraved flower on closed lid, same chain throughout. No second matching watch.
props.WATCH_OPEN: The SAME watch OPEN for the first time at 52.2; cracked glass, small photo of Hạ inside lid, hands stopped until 52.3.
props.PHOTO: Loose wallet photograph of Hạ, physically separate from the still-closed pocket watch.
props.KIEN_PHOTO: Photograph of Kiên in white suit with a hand-drawn building sketch on its back; no legible words.
props.BLACK_BOOK: Original BLACK leather ledger, receipt and original USB initially fixed inside back cover.
props.RED_BOOK: Original RED cloth ledger, handwritten signature shapes, distinct from black leather ledger.
props.RED_COPY: Paper COPY excerpt of the red ledger in a plain envelope. Originals are with the investigator after 34.5.
props.USB: Original USB from black ledger, preserved in an evidence sleeve at the station after 17.1.
props.USB_COPY: Separate working USB copy of the original, used with the borrowed laptop. Original stays in evidence.
props.TOKEN: USB-shaped hardware security token from the safe; NOT the metal door key.
props.RECEIPT: Dispatch receipt with seven dated boxes and a ship stamp, no readable generated text.
props.TIN: Dented fitted tin containing three sealed fictional Tê vials, no opening or use instructions.
props.VIAL: Fictional Tê device or sealed vial associated with the attackers. No real substance, dose or application technique.
props.VIAL_SAMPLE: ONE unopened sample carton filmed on its original shelf, then sealed as evidence; no recipe or usable label.
props.SCARF: One long pale-blue silk scarf, intact in the past before abduction.
props.SCARF_FRAGMENT: Short torn end of Hạ scarf, recovered by Sơn at the latch, later sealed with Mây. Not a full scarf.
props.SCARF_REMAINDER: Long remaining section of the SAME scarf, matching torn edge; given by Dũng to Mây, returned to Hạ at 52.5.
props.MARKS: Exactly one tally per story day at cabin frame: 1 at scene 1, 2 at 7, 3 at 12, 4 at 19, 6 after 28.5, 7 after 34.1.
props.GUN_CASE: Locked handgun case, no discharge. Sơn transfers complete case and key to Mây at 28.4 and remains unarmed thereafter.
props.GLOVES: One pair of black gloves first gifted twenty-five years ago; present-day pair left in zipped cabin bag at 35.4.
props.HAIRCLIP: Hạ silver hair clip, deliberately wedged into service-hatch latch at 45.4, recovered at 48.5 and logged at 54.5.
props.LILY: One white lily from Hạ family-home vase, wrapped at 57.5 and held at the public walkway during departure.

scenes.title: Ngày Thứ Nhất
scenes.purpose: Sơn tới Hòn Sóng và tự đặt hạn chờ.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Let the porch sea wind fall under rain on the silk-shop awning. Cut to the existing silk curtain, not to another coach arrival.

clips.start_frame: Coach door open, Sơn still inside.
clips.action: Sơn steps down once with his canvas bag, lets the coach pull away, then commits his weight toward the town only after it clears his sightline.
clips.end_frame: Sơn alone at the crossroad, bag in left hand.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Tôi phải tìm dấu cô ấy trước khi quá muộn.

clips.lighting: Soft coastal dawn, cool sea fill, gentle rising sun, no night lighting.

cinematic.intent: Make arrival feel like a deliberate loss of escape, not a travel postcard.
cinematic.composition: Keep the open coach door left of center and empty coastward space beyond Sơn.
cinematic.blocking: He clears the step once; bag stays in his left hand as the coach leaves.
cinematic.performance: His eyes follow the coach longer than his body does, then settle toward town.
cinematic.focus: Keep Sơn and the coach edge readable in the established wide depth.
cinematic.texture: Fine dust moves naturally around worn boots; jacket fabric lifts only with sea wind.
cinematic.sound_detail: Engine weight recedes continuously into exposed sea wind; narration remains dry and close.
cinematic.rhythm: Give the departure space to finish before his commitment becomes visible, without a frozen tail.

clips.start_frame: Sơn approaching the coffee stall from screen left.
clips.action: He catches a crate rolling toward the road and returns it to Bảy.
clips.end_frame: Bảy holds the recovered crate, Sơn beside the stall.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Cảm ơn chú. Cần tìm ai?

clips.lighting: Soft coastal dawn, cool sea fill, gentle rising sun, no night lighting.

cinematic.intent: Earn Bảy's later kindness through an ordinary helpful act, without making Sơn heroic.
cinematic.composition: Track at pedestrian height with the road edge and rolling crate visible together.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn intercepts the crate within his walking line, returns it, then stops beside Bảy.
cinematic.performance: He treats the recovery as routine; Bảy's surprise softens into curiosity rather than gratitude theatre.
cinematic.focus: Favor the returning crate and both upper bodies; keep the road legible behind.
cinematic.texture: Scuffed crate corners and sun-faded awning establish a working town rather than a polished set.
cinematic.sound_detail: One scrape, restrained footfall and Bảy's breath precede his thanks; no triumphant accent.
cinematic.rhythm: Let catch and return form one continuous motion, then allow the question to land.

clips.start_frame: Bảy behind his counter, Sơn facing him.
clips.action: Sơn asks for a quiet room, Bảy turns toward the dune.
clips.end_frame: Bảy pointing uphill, Sơn following his eyeline.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Chú có chỗ nào yên không?

clips.lighting: Soft coastal dawn, cool sea fill, gentle rising sun, no night lighting.

cinematic.intent: Show Sơn choosing isolation while Bảy offers practical shelter without demanding a confession.
cinematic.composition: Frame the counter as a modest boundary, both faces readable in the medium setup.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn stays on the customer side; Bảy's pointing hand opens the route toward the dune.
cinematic.performance: Sơn asks quietly without selling a cover story; Bảy answers from habit, not suspicion.
cinematic.focus: Hold both eyelines and the pointing hand at a usable shared depth.
cinematic.texture: Condensation on existing glasses and weathered counter grain give the exchange everyday weight.
cinematic.sound_detail: Keep low stall ambience below the line; let the sea remain present but unromantic.
cinematic.rhythm: Leave a fraction after the question for Bảy to understand, then follow only with eyes.

clips.start_frame: Both men already halfway up the dune path.
clips.action: They reach the cabin porch, Bảy passes Sơn the key.
clips.end_frame: Key resting in Sơn's open right palm.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Nhà trống. Gió thì không.

clips.lighting: Soft coastal dawn, cool sea fill, gentle rising sun, no night lighting.

cinematic.intent: Make receiving the key feel like accepting a temporary place, not finding safety.
cinematic.composition: Keep cabin, last stretch of path and the two men in the same wide geography.
cinematic.blocking: They finish the climb before the key passes into Sơn's open right palm.
cinematic.performance: Bảy is lightly winded and matter-of-fact; Sơn receives without the ease of a vacationer.
cinematic.focus: Maintain readable figures and the handover zone; do not cut to a separate key insert.
cinematic.texture: Pine shadows cross the sand; the small metal key looks used rather than ceremonial.
cinematic.sound_detail: Retain their breathing under the pine wind; Bảy's dry joke should not invite a music cue.
cinematic.rhythm: Spend the first beats on arrival, then let the key settle into his palm once.

clips.start_frame: Key set beside a small carving tool.
clips.action: Sơn cuts the first short mark into the bare doorframe.
clips.end_frame: One fresh mark, tool lowered out of frame.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Bảy ngày. Để tìm ra sự thật.

clips.lighting: Soft coastal dawn, cool sea fill, gentle rising sun, no night lighting.

cinematic.intent: Turn a vague stay into an exact private deadline that the audience cannot yet explain.
cinematic.composition: Use the existing detail angle on tool, clean wood and the newly cut single mark.
cinematic.blocking: His hand makes only the first short tally, then lowers the tool completely from the mark.
cinematic.performance: Express the decision through a steady wrist and controlled pressure, not a violent flourish.
cinematic.focus: Keep the cut and adjacent untouched grain sharp; the room remains unimportant beyond.
cinematic.texture: Fresh pale wood contrasts with the dark old frame; a few loose fibers catch daylight.
cinematic.sound_detail: One brief wood scrape sits beneath the voice-over; no clock tick is added here.
cinematic.rhythm: Allow recognition of the first mark before the tool leaves, while wind keeps the image alive.

clips.start_frame: Sơn seated on the porch with his closed watch.
clips.action: He turns the engraved lid toward the light without opening it.
clips.end_frame: Closed watch in his hand, sea beyond his shoulder.
clips.lighting: Soft coastal dawn, cool sea fill, gentle rising sun, no night lighting.

cinematic.intent: Attach the closed watch to a withheld emotional truth rather than explaining its contents.
cinematic.composition: Keep the watch at chest-to-lap height inside the medium frame, sea soft beyond his shoulder.
cinematic.blocking: He rotates the engraved lid into existing light without touching the release clasp.
cinematic.performance: His face should resist tears; one contained breath carries more weight than a mournful stare.
cinematic.focus: Share useful focus between his fingers and face, never revealing the hidden watch interior.
cinematic.texture: Worn silver catches a narrow natural glint; jacket cuffs and salt air remain tactile.
cinematic.sound_detail: The watch is silent in the present; only porch wood, wind and his breathing remain.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the small rotation finish, then stay on the consequence without a second turn.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Sơn đang tìm nơi bắt đầu lại hay chỗ để biến mất?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Một người xuống xe biến thành người tự đếm ngược bảy ngày.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Anh để chuyến xe rời đi rồi mới bước về thị trấn.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Lựa chọn chỗ ngồi, đồng hồ đóng và vạch đầu gieo cho 03, 34, 52, 60.

scenes.title: Quá Khứ: Hợp Đồng Cuối
scenes.purpose: Bà Hai giao việc cuối và Dũng lộ sự ghen tức.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Match the rectangle of the building sketch to the stall mirror edge. Replace city rain with present-day coastal morning sound.

clips.start_frame: Silk curtain at left, three figures around a teak desk.
clips.action: Sơn stops before Bà Hai, Dũng quietly closes the rear door.
clips.end_frame: Sơn standing opposite Bà Hai, Dũng by the shut door.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC
dialogue.text: Ngồi đi con.

clips.lighting: Night interior, warm desk lamp and shop practicals, wet alley beyond.

cinematic.intent: Introduce a household invitation whose geometry already limits Sơn's freedom to leave.
cinematic.composition: Keep Bà Hai behind the desk and Dũng near the rear door within one wide frame.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn stops at the desk edge while Dũng closes the door softly behind his path.
cinematic.performance: Bà Hai's warmth is practiced and genuine enough to unsettle; Dũng avoids a theatrical glare.
cinematic.focus: Keep all three positions legible, with the door not swallowed by excessive blur.
cinematic.texture: Silk absorbs the warm lamp light while the desk retains a hard reflective edge.
cinematic.sound_detail: Door latch is quiet but distinct; her invitation stays conversational, without a sinister sting.
cinematic.rhythm: Hold the small delay between door closure and invitation so the room's control becomes apparent.

clips.start_frame: Bà Hai's left hand beside a face-down photograph.
clips.action: She slides Kiên's portrait toward Sơn, jade bracelet visible.
clips.end_frame: Kiên's portrait beside Sơn's black glove.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC
dialogue.text: Kiên giữ sổ gốc. Má cần lấy lại.

clips.lighting: Night interior, warm desk lamp and shop practicals, wet alley beyond.

cinematic.intent: Let a single sliding photograph define the transaction more clearly than exposition can.
cinematic.composition: Place the bracelet, portrait and Sơn's black glove within the same stable detail plane.
cinematic.blocking: Her left hand slides the photograph toward his glove and stops before touching him.
cinematic.performance: The hand is unhurried and assumes compliance; his glove remains still long enough to register refusal.
cinematic.focus: Keep the photographed face readable as a picture, not an extra living person in the room.
cinematic.texture: Jade and paper move against polished wood; the glove's matte leather interrupts both reflections.
cinematic.sound_detail: A soft paper drag and faint bracelet contact support her off-screen sentence, not compete with it.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the portrait reach its final position before the last word, leaving its offer unanswered.

clips.start_frame: Sơn facing Bà Hai across the desk.
clips.action: He leaves the photograph untouched and sets a return ticket down.
clips.end_frame: Ticket between the two, Sơn's hands still.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Xong việc này, con nghỉ.

clips.lighting: Night interior, warm desk lamp and shop practicals, wet alley beyond.

cinematic.intent: Give Sơn's wish to leave a concrete cost by putting his return ticket between them.
cinematic.composition: Use the medium composition to include his face and the ticket landing near the desk edge.
cinematic.blocking: He sets the ticket down once and leaves Kiên's portrait untouched where it was offered.
cinematic.performance: His voice is restrained; the stillness afterward should look rehearsed, because he expects resistance.
cinematic.focus: Keep the ticket shape visible without readable print while his eyes remain the emotional center.
cinematic.texture: The thin ticket lies exposed against heavy wood and dense folded silk nearby.
cinematic.sound_detail: A small paper tap should be heard before the sentence ends; keep room tone steady.
cinematic.rhythm: Deliver the line without rushing into defense, then let Bà Hai own the silence he leaves.

clips.action: Bà Hai covers the ticket with a folded strip of silk.
clips.end_frame: Her hand rests on the silk covering Sơn's ticket.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC
dialogue.text: Con đi thì ai giữ nhà cho má?

clips.lighting: Night interior, warm desk lamp and shop practicals, wet alley beyond.

cinematic.intent: Show Bà Hai answering departure with possession through an almost affectionate domestic gesture.
cinematic.composition: Keep the exact prior medium setup, positions and lens; the desk remains the shared boundary.
cinematic.blocking: Her folded silk covers the ticket once, leaving her left hand resting on top.
cinematic.performance: She asks as though appealing to family; Sơn's jaw tightens without a visible argument starting.
cinematic.focus: Preserve the previous depth and eyelines instead of inventing a new close-up on her hand.
cinematic.texture: Soft fabric settling over paper makes the ticket disappear through an ordinary, reversible act.
cinematic.sound_detail: Silk rub replaces the paper sound; her gentle line should remain more troubling than a raised voice.
cinematic.rhythm: Use a measured cover and a brief still response; nobody repeats the ticket placement.

clips.start_frame: Dũng holding the rear door for Sơn.
clips.action: Dũng looks at the untouched chair, then blocks the doorway briefly.
clips.end_frame: Sơn and Dũng separated by the door edge.

dialogue.speaker: DUNG
dialogue.text: Má để ghế cho mày hoài.

clips.lighting: Night interior, warm desk lamp and shop practicals, wet alley beyond.

cinematic.intent: Make Dũng's jealousy specific to the place Sơn receives in the household.
cinematic.composition: Frame over Sơn's near shoulder toward Dũng's three-quarter face and the rear door edge.
cinematic.blocking: Dũng glances at the unused chair, then occupies the doorway just long enough to matter.
cinematic.performance: His resentment should arrive through an almost casual remark; Sơn does not reward it with a taunt.
cinematic.focus: Keep Dũng's mouth and the blocking door edge clear, with the chair only a secondary cue.
cinematic.texture: The narrow opening compresses bodies against hanging silk and a scuffed door jamb.
cinematic.sound_detail: Door wood shifts under his hand; the spoken complaint carries no added threat effect.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the chair glance precede the line, then release the doorway only after its meaning settles.

clips.start_frame: Sơn already outside, silk door closing behind him.
clips.action: He turns Kiên's photo over and studies a building entrance sketch.
clips.end_frame: Photo back beside the real tower across the street.
clips.lighting: Night interior, warm desk lamp and shop practicals, wet alley beyond.

cinematic.intent: Connect the assigned target to a real place before the audience sees the woman living there.
cinematic.composition: Use the slow push to keep Sơn, the turning photo and tower in a single spatial relationship.
cinematic.blocking: He turns the photograph once to its sketch side, aligning it with the actual entrance across the street.
cinematic.performance: His attention is professional and narrow; no anticipatory romantic expression belongs here yet.
cinematic.focus: Favor his reading distance and the sketch edge, while leaving the tower recognizable beyond.
cinematic.texture: Rain speckles the existing photograph sleeve and darkens the alley wall without obscuring the sketch.
cinematic.sound_detail: City rain replaces shop softness; avoid an invented phone, engine arrival or future flower-shop bell.
cinematic.rhythm: The turn is brief, the comparison takes longer, and the final frame becomes a purposeful eyeline.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Ơn nuôi dưỡng của Bà Hai có cho Sơn quyền rời đi không?

scenes.title: Khách Không Nhìn Biển

clips.start_frame: Rectangular stall mirror under the green tarp, Sơn at the sea-facing table edge.

dialogue.text: Biển phía sau chú kìa.

scenes.title: Quá Khứ: Ba Lần Ghé Tiệm

dialogue.text: Anh mua hoa cho ai?

clips.end_frame: Vase safe between their hands, Sơn releases it first.

clips.start_frame: Same window chair on the following afternoon, fresh flowers changed.

clips.end_frame: Two lilies in separate paper sleeves, Hạ suppressing a smile.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.text: Hôm nay vẫn người đó hả?

clips.lighting: Warm afternoon window light in the recent-past flower shop, no night grade.

cinematic.blocking: Hạ places the second lily before he asks, withdrawing her hand rather than pushing it at him.

clips.start_frame: Hạ facing the window, Sơn beside the second lily.

clips.lighting: Warm afternoon window light in the recent-past flower shop, no night grade.

cinematic.blocking: She looks once toward the lobby, returns to his face and simply waits.
cinematic.performance: Curiosity stays warmer than suspicion; Sơn's attention leaves the lobby reluctantly but completely for this beat.

cinematic.texture: Window reflections move softly across flower buckets; neither person touches a new object.
cinematic.sound_detail: No line is needed; let distant street noise expose the silence between their shared looks.

clips.start_frame: Third afternoon, Sơn holding a repaired bucket handle.

clips.end_frame: Hạ holding the repaired bucket, Sơn with empty hands.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.text: Anh nhớ cái xô hơn nhớ tiền.

cinematic.blocking: He returns the repaired bucket, letting her take its weight before his hands leave it.
cinematic.performance: Sơn avoids pride; Hạ's joke should be affectionate surprise at practical attention, not a laugh track setup.
cinematic.focus: Keep the repaired area visible without pretending its mechanism needs an instructional close-up.
cinematic.texture: Scuffed plastic remains scuffed; the repair is modest and used, not magically replaced by a new bucket.
cinematic.sound_detail: A light handle creak and her line carry the moment, with no reward flourish in the music.
cinematic.rhythm: Hold the awkward emptiness of his hands after the handover before she finishes noticing the gesture.

clips.start_frame: Sơn standing by the open shop door.

clips.end_frame: Sơn staying in the doorway, Hạ smiling behind the counter.
clips.lighting: Warm afternoon window light in the recent-past flower shop, no night grade.

cinematic.blocking: He starts to leave but arrests the departure within the doorway, turning only once toward her.
cinematic.performance: His face softens without an instant grin; her laugh subsides naturally when she realizes he listened.
cinematic.focus: Favor his reaction while retaining enough of Hạ to show who caused it, no new reverse shot.
cinematic.texture: Door glass and flower wrapping carry late light; no new flower is exchanged here.
cinematic.sound_detail: Let her existing laughter trail into normal shop sound; avoid adding dialogue to fill the silence.
cinematic.rhythm: His halted exit is the event, so spend the remaining seconds on the decision rather than another step.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Một người chỉ nhìn mục tiêu có chịu nhìn Hạ không?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Ba lần ghé thay từ theo dõi tòa nhà sang tự nguyện ở lại.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Chuông tiệm vang nhưng Sơn nhìn qua vai người bán hoa.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Việc sửa xô và chọn nán lại làm tình cảm có hành vi, tránh chỉ dựa vào lời tán tỉnh.

scenes.title: Sổ Đen Và Hạn Chót
scenes.purpose: Giới thiệu bằng chứng bị lấy và lịch giao hàng trong bảy ngày.
scenes.outgoing_audio: The meal container settling at the cabin door bridges to the flower-shop cash drawer. Do not replay the tin being closed.

dialogue.text: Tôi mang theo thứ họ cần bịt lại.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon daylight through cabin gaps, cooler shadows, no fluorescent source.

cinematic.sound_detail: Use tape lift and paper separation as small clear sounds; no electronic chime belongs to an unplugged USB.

clips.end_frame: His fingertip on the last box beside the ship stamp.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon daylight through cabin gaps, cooler shadows, no fluorescent source.

cinematic.composition: Keep the exact preceding detail setup, USB and receipt still sharing the same table orientation.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn follows the existing sequence of boxes once, stopping at the ship stamp rather than tapping repeatedly.
cinematic.performance: The fingertip becomes firmer at the last box; his off-screen voice remains controlled rather than prophetic.
cinematic.focus: Retain the same focus plane as the receipt reveal, with the final box and stamp readable as shapes.
cinematic.texture: A curled paper corner shifts in the cabin breeze while his finger keeps the relevant area flat.
cinematic.sound_detail: One fingertip drag under the sentence, no added ticking or departing ship sound to overstate the clue.

clips.start_frame: Sơn below the cabin's exposed roof beam.

clips.end_frame: Case hidden above the beam, Sơn's empty hands below.

cinematic.sound_detail: A restrained case-to-wood contact and his exhale are sufficient; never add a weapon-cocking sound.

clips.start_frame: Bảy at the porch threshold carrying a meal.

dialogue.text: Ăn đi. Sáng nay chú đỡ tui cái thùng.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Trong túi Sơn có gì khiến người khác phải tìm tới?

scenes.title: Quá Khứ: Lời Mời Về Biển
scenes.purpose: Hạ đặt giới hạn rồi tặng đồng hồ như một lời hẹn.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Let the kettle hiss finish. Cut to the next morning doorframe and its second tally, daylight replacing the warm room.

clips.start_frame: Hạ putting the day's cash away, Sơn near the rear door.

clips.end_frame: Hạ's hand resting on the cash drawer, distance between them.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.text: Anh làm việc gì vậy?

clips.lighting: Recent-past night, warm back-room bulbs and soft street spill, kettle steam.

cinematic.blocking: His jacket shifts in existing movement, revealing the closed holster; her working hand stops where it is.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.text: Em không muốn sống trong lời giấu.

cinematic.texture: The closed drawer and unoccupied table space create a practical gap, not a symbolic lighting transformation.

dialogue.text: Anh muốn dừng. Chưa biết cách.

cinematic.blocking: Sơn removes only the right glove and lays it on the table, left glove remaining on.

cinematic.texture: The bare skin against matte black leather gives a quiet material contrast under the same warm light.
cinematic.sound_detail: Leather pulling free and a small tabletop landing accompany his low line, with the kettle still present.
cinematic.rhythm: The glove comes off in one measured action; his admission follows instead of being stretched over every finger.

clips.start_frame: Hạ holding a closed silver pocket watch by its chain.

clips.start_frame: Hạ extending the watch toward Sơn's bare right hand.

clips.end_frame: Sơn holding the closed watch, Hạ's hand withdrawn.

dialogue.speaker: HA

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn right hand bare, left hand still gloved. He retrieves the loose right glove before leaving.
clips.lighting: Recent-past night, warm back-room bulbs and soft street spill, kettle steam.

cinematic.texture: The thin chain moves naturally against his palm, while the single loose glove remains where it was left.
cinematic.sound_detail: Her sentence should be intimate and clear above the quiet tick, with no swelling score sealing the promise.

clips.end_frame: His bare hand returns for the glove, Hạ turns off the kettle.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Anh sẽ về nói thật với em.

clips.lighting: Recent-past night, warm back-room bulbs and soft street spill, kettle steam.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Sơn có thể nói thật mà không mất người anh muốn giữ không?

scenes.title: Mây Gõ Cửa

scenes.outgoing_audio: Introduce garage ventilation hum before the flashback cut away from the station radio and folder.

clips.start_frame: One mark on the doorframe, tool below it.

clips.start_frame: Mây at the doorway with the card, Sơn beside the table.

clips.end_frame: Card returned to Sơn, notebook still open.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Anh định ở tới khi nào?

cinematic.intent: Make Mây compare a person to a document without performing instant guilt detection.

cinematic.performance: Her question is open rather than accusatory; his stillness should invite scrutiny without announcing a villain.
cinematic.focus: Keep Mây's speaking face readable past Sơn's near edge, with card detail secondary rather than legible text.
cinematic.texture: Window light grazes the card and notebook paper, while the interior beyond remains modest and spare.
cinematic.sound_detail: Her paper and card handling stays soft below the question, with the outside motorcycle now quiet.

clips.start_frame: Sơn beside the two fresh marks.

clips.end_frame: Mây's eyeline fixed on the doorframe.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Hết tuần này.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning daylight, neutral station window fill for station shots.

cinematic.intent: Tie Sơn's evasive answer to the visible count so Mây gains a behavioral fact.
cinematic.composition: The medium composition holds Sơn beside the two fresh marks and Mây's reaction in the same space.
cinematic.blocking: He looks toward the marks instead of directly at her, then gives the limited answer without moving away.
cinematic.performance: He should not smirk at withholding information; Mây registers the relationship and lets it remain unanswered.
cinematic.focus: Keep his glance and her receiving eyeline clear, avoiding a new insert that would repeat the carving shot.
cinematic.texture: Fresh wood remains pale against the old frame, with daylight holding the same direction as the visit.
cinematic.sound_detail: A brief pause before his short answer should be heard as reluctance, not filled by a ticking cue.
cinematic.rhythm: Use the silence to let Mây follow his glance, then end with her attention on the count.

clips.start_frame: Thành at the old computer, Mây standing behind him.

clips.end_frame: Printer feeding one page, Mây taking it.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Giấy không khớp hồ sơ, chị.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning daylight, neutral station window fill for station shots.

cinematic.performance: Their hands become more deliberate at the mismatch; no visible actor needs an exaggerated shocked face.

cinematic.texture: Old plastic keys and lightly curled paper make the modest station tools feel used and practical.
cinematic.sound_detail: Printer rollers and a single page feed support Thành's off-screen finding; no digital alarm is necessary.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the paper emerge at ordinary speed, then give the fact room to land before filing it.

clips.start_frame: Mây laying the result in a new investigation folder.

clips.end_frame: Folder open with Sơn's rental note, Thành calling for support.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Theo người tìm anh ta nữa.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning daylight, neutral station window fill for station shots.

cinematic.intent: Show Mây choosing a method of investigation, keeping suspicion separate from proof.

cinematic.blocking: She files the mismatch and assigns discreet observation while Thành begins the support request.
cinematic.performance: Mây is purposeful, not conspiratorial; Thành's readiness makes this feel like coordinated work rather than a secret favor.
cinematic.focus: Keep her face and the open folder readable, with the radio work secondary in the same setup.
cinematic.texture: Plain paper and the rental note give the inquiry physical continuity instead of another screen display.
cinematic.sound_detail: The support channel opens quietly beneath her instruction, maintaining a working-station bed after the paper reveal.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Giấy tờ giả sẽ khiến Mây bắt ngay hay theo dấu người truy tìm?

scenes.title: Quá Khứ: Đêm Bị Gài
scenes.purpose: Sơn bị gài với bằng chứng giả và đồng hồ hỏng khi thoát.
scenes.outgoing_audio: City rain falls away, the arriving black car establishes present-day afternoon. Do not replay the garage escape.

clips.start_frame: Sơn behind a pillar, a white car at the far lift.
clips.action: He checks the lift reflection without drawing his handgun.
clips.end_frame: Sơn concealed behind the pillar, lift doors opening.
clips.lighting: Recent-past garage at night, amber fluorescent practicals, moving search beams, no gunfire.

cinematic.intent: Create anticipation by letting the expected lift and white car occupy space before the wrong man appears.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide garage view to connect Sơn's pillar, reflective surface, lift and waiting white car.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn checks the lift through reflection without drawing or changing pillars before the doors begin to open.
cinematic.performance: His professional patience carries unease only when the lift opens, not from a constant frightened expression.
cinematic.focus: Retain readable route depth; the reflection should be plausible at this angle, not a magical close-up inside a mirror.
cinematic.texture: Concrete bands and restrained yellow practicals organize the garage, with a faint wet sheen near the ramp.
cinematic.sound_detail: Ventilation hum, distant tire resonance and the actual lift movement build the pause without a score ramp.
cinematic.rhythm: Spend time on expectation, then let the doors start opening near the end rather than revealing Dũng early.

clips.end_frame: Envelope on the floor between them, Dũng in front of the lift.

dialogue.speaker: DUNG
dialogue.text: Má đổi chỗ giao. Nhặt đi.

clips.lighting: Recent-past garage at night, amber fluorescent practicals, moving search beams, no gunfire.

cinematic.intent: Make Dũng's familiar presence feel wrong through his handling of the envelope and blocked exit.
cinematic.composition: The medium setup keeps Dũng's speaking face, shoe and floor envelope in a readable vertical relationship.
cinematic.blocking: He slides the envelope once with his shoe and stays between Sơn and the lift opening.
cinematic.performance: His casual instruction should sound rehearsed; Sơn's body stays contained rather than immediately attacking.
cinematic.focus: Hold Dũng's mouth and the envelope landing area readable, without an extra low-angle insert.
cinematic.texture: Scuffed shoe leather drags over concrete, while the envelope looks ordinary enough to be plausible work.
cinematic.sound_detail: A dry paper scrape ends before the line's final word, lift ambience continuing behind his voice.
cinematic.rhythm: The slide is quick and dismissive; the wait afterward gives Sơn time to notice what is wrong.

clips.start_frame: Sơn's gloved hand above the open envelope.
clips.action: He sees his own staged photograph and a stolen seal inside.
clips.end_frame: His hand withdrawing from the planted evidence.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Mày muốn tao nhận cái này.

clips.lighting: Recent-past garage at night, amber fluorescent practicals, moving search beams, no gunfire.

cinematic.intent: Let recognition of the planted evidence change the meaning of the meeting before the chase begins.

cinematic.performance: Recognition should appear through arrested fingers and a controlled retreat, not an invented face reaction within the insert.
cinematic.focus: Keep both items recognizable as shapes, with no legible legal text or inexplicably sharp hidden document.
cinematic.texture: Worn photograph edges and the seal's hard outline contrast with the soft envelope flap and black glove.
cinematic.sound_detail: Only paper movement and his low off-screen sentence break the garage hum; do not add a camera shutter effect.
cinematic.rhythm: Give the viewer a fraction to read the trap before his hand retreats and the accusation lands.

clips.start_frame: Light beams sweeping toward Sơn's pillar.
clips.action: He ducks behind a parked car, the closed watch strikes concrete.
clips.end_frame: Sơn behind the car with the watch chain taut, alarm sounding.
clips.lighting: Recent-past garage at night, amber fluorescent practicals, moving search beams, no gunfire.

cinematic.intent: Turn the trap into immediate physical pressure and damage the watch without making it an action trophy.
cinematic.composition: Keep the handheld medium-wide on the pillar, nearby parked car and Sơn's crouching path from one side.
cinematic.blocking: He ducks behind the car in one defensive movement; the pocketed watch hits concrete as his body folds.
cinematic.performance: Fear shows as a sudden narrowed breath, then he regains control instead of posing through danger.
cinematic.focus: Keep his whole defensive movement readable, not a separate slow-motion watch impact or disorienting lens change.
cinematic.texture: Search beams move across existing concrete and car paint, leaving the concealed space readable at the end.
cinematic.sound_detail: One dull metal knock is swallowed by alarm and footsteps; no firearm discharge or impact on a body is added.
cinematic.rhythm: The duck is fast, the concealed breathing interval longer, leaving the chain tension as a consequence.

clips.start_frame: Sơn at a low maintenance door, jacket still on.

clips.end_frame: Sơn outside the closed maintenance door, black gloves still on.
clips.lighting: Recent-past garage at night, amber fluorescent practicals, moving search beams, no gunfire.

cinematic.composition: Track laterally with Sơn through the existing low door and into the sheltered lane, retaining the established direction.
cinematic.blocking: He slips through once, pulls the door shut and stays outside it with both black gloves still worn.
cinematic.performance: He is economical but physically taxed; a delayed inhale after the closure keeps him human.
cinematic.focus: Keep his jacket, door edge and exiting body readable, without changing to an impossible interior view mid-shot.
cinematic.texture: Rain-darkened door paint and his damp suit carry the garage into the lane without adding a costume reset.
cinematic.sound_detail: Door latch and receding garage alarm connect the spaces, his footfalls changing surface naturally.
cinematic.rhythm: The door closes only after his body clears it; allow the first safe breath to finish the movement.

clips.start_frame: Sơn under the rear awning, closed watch in his hand.

clips.end_frame: His face turning toward the distant flower shop.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Đêm đó, thứ đầu tiên ngừng là đồng hồ.

clips.lighting: Recent-past garage at night, amber fluorescent practicals, moving search beams, no gunfire.

cinematic.composition: The restrained push holds his closed watch near his face and the distant shop-light direction beyond.
cinematic.blocking: He listens at the lid without opening it, then turns toward the lights once the silence registers.
cinematic.performance: His voice-over stays retrospective and dry; present expression is concentration giving way to alarm, not performed grief yet.
cinematic.focus: Favor his face and closed case at a sensible reading distance, leaving the shop as a distant light cue.
cinematic.texture: Wet lapel edges and muted silver retain the night's wear, with no inner watch face exposed.
cinematic.sound_detail: Suppress any ticking completely; rain drips and his breathing remain under the narration and distant city bed.
cinematic.rhythm: Leave a small listening interval before the turn, so absence of sound motivates where his attention goes.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Ai đáng ra ra khỏi thang máy, và tại sao Dũng thay người đó?

dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Đồng hồ dừng gieo cho 52; quần áo và găng vẫn theo Sơn tới tiệm hoa.

scenes.title: Hai Người Lạ

clips.end_frame: Phone hidden beneath the counter, Bảy still holding the photo.

dialogue.text: Họ tìm người. Ta tìm đường đi.

clips.lighting: Present-day afternoon sun, bright road outside cool stall and market shade.

cinematic.intent: Convert scattered observations into a direction of inquiry, giving Mây a discovery instead of instant certainty.

cinematic.blocking: Thành places his notes beside the card; Mây aligns only the company emblem relationship and requests verification.
