cinematic.rhythm: Pause on the match before the instruction; avoid reading every plate, emblem and company detail aloud again.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Bảy che được Sơn bao lâu trước khi người lạ hiểu thị trấn này?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Lời hỏi người trở thành manh mối về tuyến vận chuyển.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Hai người tìm cùng một sẹo, Bảy vẫn giữ nhịp lau quán.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Vòng tay công ty, biển số và danh thiếp hợp thành ba nguồn đối chiếu thay vì đoán.

scenes.title: Quá Khứ: Dấu Vết Còn Lại
scenes.purpose: Sơn nhặt một mảnh khăn và lấy sổ từ kho mình biết.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Match the closed bag clasp to the sealed tin latch in the lamplit cabin. No second theft or opening of the tin.

clips.start_frame: Broken shop glass, a pale-blue strip caught on the latch.
clips.action: Sơn enters carefully and stops at the torn strip.
clips.end_frame: Sơn facing the latch, torn strip still attached.
clips.lighting: Recent-past dawn after rain, pale shop window light, dim stockroom practical.

cinematic.intent: Make absence tangible through a small deliberate trace within a damaged familiar space.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide shop view to retain broken glass, displaced flowers and the pale-blue strip at the latch together.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn enters carefully along a clear footpath and stops before touching the strip.
cinematic.performance: His body should slow as recognition arrives, keeping shock inward rather than dropping immediately to his knees.
cinematic.focus: Allow the strip to be findable within the room, without an artificial spotlight or a sudden detail cut.
cinematic.texture: Damaged paper sleeves and damp flower stems echo the living shop without adding evidence of unseen graphic harm.
cinematic.sound_detail: Muted wind through the broken door and a cautious footstep replace the former welcoming bell.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the audience search the space with him, then stop on the found strip before recovery begins next shot.

clips.start_frame: Sơn's right glove beside the broken latch.
clips.action: He removes the glove once and frees only the small torn strip.
clips.end_frame: Bare right hand holding the short scarf fragment.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Hạ để lại cái này.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn right glove removed at 10.2 and kept in jacket pocket, left glove still on; jacket never discarded.
clips.lighting: Recent-past dawn after rain, pale shop window light, dim stockroom practical.

cinematic.intent: Distinguish the recovered short fragment from the larger scarf so the later threat has physical meaning.
cinematic.composition: Hold the detail frame on latch, right glove and the small attached strip, preserving their scale.
cinematic.blocking: He removes only the right glove, stores it, and frees the short torn end without taking a full scarf.
cinematic.performance: Bare fingertips become more tentative than the gloved approach; his spoken recognition should be almost involuntary.
cinematic.focus: Keep the torn edge and hand sharp, not an insert of Hạ's face or the watch interior.
cinematic.texture: Blue fibers catch on the already damaged latch; slight fraying matters more than a dramatic tear effect.
cinematic.sound_detail: A soft fabric release and his off-screen name for the trace carry the beat, with room wind uninterrupted.
cinematic.rhythm: Take enough time to show what comes free, then leave the small piece clearly resting in his palm.

clips.start_frame: Sơn near the broken doorway, a neighbor outside the frame.
clips.action: He listens to the neighbor describe a black car and three men.
clips.end_frame: Sơn looking toward the tire tracks outside.

dialogue.speaker: EXTRA
dialogue.text: Cổ bị đưa đi. Còn quay lại nhìn cửa.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn right glove removed at 10.2 and kept in jacket pocket, left glove still on; jacket never discarded.
clips.lighting: Recent-past dawn after rain, pale shop window light, dim stockroom practical.

cinematic.intent: Let the witness offer facts while Sơn supplies the fear, preserving uncertainty about Hạ's fate.
cinematic.composition: The medium setup stays on Sơn at the damaged doorway, neighbor speaking from the established off-screen side.
cinematic.blocking: He listens toward the neighbor, then follows the described departure toward tire tracks outside with his gaze.
cinematic.performance: His face should sharpen at the direction of the car, avoiding relief or certainty the testimony cannot support.
cinematic.focus: Hold his listening face and doorway relationship; do not invent a new neighbor portrait or readable tire-code close-up.
cinematic.texture: Moist pavement beyond the door provides a plausible trace direction while flower debris remains near his feet.
cinematic.sound_detail: Keep the witness voice slightly outside and local, with no processed threatening effect or reconstructed abduction screams.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the factual sentence finish before his eyes move, so the direction feels learned rather than clairvoyant.

clips.start_frame: Sơn's phone vibrating against his jacket.
clips.action: He answers, hears Bà Hai claim Hạ has left him, ends the call.
clips.end_frame: Phone lowered, Sơn's bare right hand steady again.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC
dialogue.text: Về tiệm, má còn giữ chỗ cho con.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn right glove removed at 10.2 and kept in jacket pocket, left glove still on; jacket never discarded.
clips.lighting: Recent-past dawn after rain, pale shop window light, dim stockroom practical.

cinematic.intent: Make Bà Hai's familiar reassurance sound like a trap when Sơn can no longer accept it.
cinematic.composition: Use the close-up to hold his face and phone edge without displaying the caller or an animated screen portrait.
cinematic.blocking: He answers once, hears the invitation and lowers the phone after ending the call himself.
cinematic.performance: His anger is controlled into a steadier bare right hand, not a shouted reply or a visible rage tremor.
cinematic.focus: Favor his eyes and the phone at a natural distance; keep any screen content unreadable and secondary.
cinematic.texture: Rain still clings to his suit edge, contrasting with the dry composure returning to his face.
cinematic.sound_detail: The filtered familiar voice stays soft, then cuts cleanly to the damaged shop's real ambience.
cinematic.rhythm: Allow her sweetness to finish before he terminates the call, leaving the refusal as an action rather than extra dialogue.

clips.start_frame: Rear stockroom door of the silk shop closed before opening hours.
clips.action: Sơn uses his old key and reaches the shelf he once guarded.
clips.end_frame: Sơn beside the stock shelf, black ledger and tin visible.
clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn right glove removed at 10.2 and kept in jacket pocket, left glove still on; jacket never discarded.
clips.lighting: Recent-past dawn after rain, pale shop window light, dim stockroom practical.

cinematic.intent: Make taking evidence a conscious alternative to obeying Bà Hai's invitation, using a place Sơn knows.
cinematic.composition: Track along the rear stockroom entry toward the familiar shelf, keeping the route in one direction.
cinematic.blocking: His existing key opens the same rear access and remains with him as he reaches the shelf.
cinematic.performance: His manner is purposeful but not excited; familiarity should reduce searching, making the choice feel morally deliberate.
cinematic.focus: Keep Sơn and the target shelf readable as he enters, rather than cutting to an unexplained object location.
cinematic.texture: Old latch wear and dust patterns indicate routine access, without adding a new hidden compartment or password cue.
cinematic.sound_detail: One restrained latch sound gives way to morning city noise outside and his quiet steps inside.
cinematic.rhythm: Move directly to the known shelf; do not spend the full clip on a suspenseful unlock that solves no new problem.

clips.start_frame: Ledger and sealed tin on the stockroom shelf.
clips.action: Sơn takes the ledger, attached receipt and sealed tin into his bag.
clips.end_frame: Shelf empty at those slots, bag clasp closed.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Tôi lấy sổ của họ. Không lấy lại được cô ấy.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn right glove removed at 10.2 and kept in jacket pocket, left glove still on; jacket never discarded.
clips.lighting: Recent-past dawn after rain, pale shop window light, dim stockroom practical.

cinematic.intent: Pay off the origin of the evidence while letting Sơn admit that it cannot replace the missing person.
cinematic.composition: The medium composition keeps ledger, receipt, sealed tin and open bag together at the known shelf.
cinematic.blocking: He takes those existing items in one purposeful packing sequence and closes the clasp after the shelf slots empty.
cinematic.performance: The narration carries regret rather than pride at a successful theft; hands remain disciplined through it.
cinematic.focus: Keep the difference between emptied shelf positions and packed objects understandable without individual hero inserts.
cinematic.texture: Black ledger leather, folded receipt and dented tin retain their distinct textures inside the plain canvas bag.
cinematic.sound_detail: Use subdued object contacts and one final clasp, with no triumph cue or unshown alarm effect.
cinematic.rhythm: Do not pause to reintroduce each object; the empty slots and final closed bag complete the consequence.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Hạ để lại dấu hay chỉ để lại thứ Sơn muốn tin?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Một mảnh khăn cho thấy bị đưa đi; Sơn chọn lấy chứng cứ thay vì trở về nhận lệnh.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Cả tiệm hỏng nhưng một mảnh xanh mắc đúng vị trí.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Mảnh ngắn chưa là khăn đầy đủ; nguồn sổ và tin được trả lời để không xuất hiện thần kỳ.

scenes.title: Bảy Ngày Không Chạy
scenes.purpose: Mây nhìn thấy nguy cơ, Sơn chấp nhận để lại một đường liên lạc.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Carry pine wind across the night-to-morning cut, with a clear daylight change. The third mark is a new action.

clips.start_frame: Closed tin beside the dispatch receipt under lamplight.
clips.action: Sơn puts a pencil mark at the last shipping date, leaving the tin sealed.
clips.end_frame: Receipt weighted flat by the sealed tin.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Chuyến hàng đi rồi, dấu vết cũng đi.

clips.lighting: Present-day night, warm cabin lamp inside, cool moonlit pines outside.

cinematic.intent: Revisit the shipping date as a decision to act on it, not a repeated explanation of the same clue.
cinematic.composition: Match the bag-clasp geometry into the existing sealed tin and receipt under the cabin lamp.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn makes one small pencil mark at the final date and weights the paper with the still-sealed tin.
cinematic.performance: The marking pressure is firmer than the earlier tracing, indicating commitment rather than a new discovery.
cinematic.focus: Keep pencil, final box and tin edge at the same stable detail depth; handwritten words stay unreadable.
cinematic.texture: Warm lamplight catches the paper crease while the closed tin remains a dull, practical weight.
cinematic.sound_detail: Pencil drag and tin settling replace the earlier USB tape sounds, with night pine wind underneath.
cinematic.rhythm: Make the marking brief and the resulting weighted paper clear, leaving the voice-over no reason to repeat all seven boxes.

clips.start_frame: Sơn seated with a loose photograph of Hạ from his wallet.
clips.action: He places the photograph face down when a distant motorcycle stops.
clips.end_frame: Loose photograph face down, Sơn looking toward the window.
clips.lighting: Present-day night, warm cabin lamp inside, cool moonlit pines outside.

cinematic.intent: Show Sơn guarding a private attachment when he suspects observation, without revealing the watch early.
cinematic.composition: The medium view holds his face, loose wallet portrait and cabin window within the same quiet arrangement.
cinematic.blocking: He turns the separate photograph face down once when the distant motorcycle stops, then looks toward the window.
cinematic.performance: The concealment is protective and ashamed rather than evidence-destroying; his face changes before the hand finishes.
cinematic.focus: Keep the loose photograph clearly outside any watch, with his eyeline toward the window readable.
cinematic.texture: The portrait's thin paper edge and worn wallet distinguish it from the heavy closed silver case.
cinematic.sound_detail: A faint paper touch follows the distant engine settling; the silent present-day watch adds no tick.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the outside sound motivate the turn, then stay with the changed attention instead of flipping the photo again.

clips.start_frame: Mây behind a pine trunk overlooking the lit cabin.
clips.action: She notices a dark case edge in the beam recess through the window and records the hiding place as a suspicion.
clips.end_frame: Binoculars lowered, Mây recording the observation.
clips.lighting: Present-day night, warm cabin lamp inside, cool moonlit pines outside.

cinematic.intent: Make Mây's observation a plausible suspicion about a hiding place, preserving uncertainty and investigative discipline.
cinematic.composition: Use the shoulder perspective from behind the pine, with the cabin window occupying a small believable sightline.
cinematic.blocking: She observes through binoculars, lowers them and notes the beam recess rather than seeing through solid wood.
cinematic.performance: Her expression should acknowledge incompleteness; she records carefully instead of reacting as though the case contents are proven.
cinematic.focus: Keep Mây and her sightline coherent, not a magical sharp zoom from distant tree to concealed interior.
cinematic.texture: Pine bark and needles interrupt the foreground; warm cabin light reaches only the parts actually exposed.
cinematic.sound_detail: Keep near wind and the quiet notebook movement, with no distant interior sound magically audible to her.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the observation take time, but end on the note that distinguishes seeing from assuming.

clips.start_frame: Thành joining Mây below the ridge.
clips.action: He hands her confirmation that the black car belongs to the dock company.
clips.end_frame: Company report in Mây's hand, cabin light behind them.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Xe cùng công ty trên tờ giao hàng.

clips.lighting: Present-day night, warm cabin lamp inside, cool moonlit pines outside.

cinematic.intent: Use Thành's report to tighten the connection between the visitors and shipping evidence, without another revelation speech.
cinematic.composition: Frame both below the ridge, keeping the cabin light in the background as a steady reference.
cinematic.blocking: Thành hands the existing confirmation to Mây; she receives it without turning openly toward the cabin.
cinematic.performance: He delivers the finding low and efficiently, while her response is a silent recalibration rather than astonishment.
cinematic.focus: Hold their faces and paper handover at shared depth, avoiding a new company-logo insert.
cinematic.texture: Paper edges catch the cabin glow; pine shadow remains irregular and natural around their shoulders.
cinematic.sound_detail: Their restrained voices sit close under the pine wind, with no phone chime announcing the report.
cinematic.rhythm: One clear handover and a short processing pause are enough; let the light behind them retain the unresolved subject.

clips.start_frame: Sơn at the cabin window with the watch lid still closed.
clips.action: He senses the observer, switches on the porch light and steps slightly back within the visible window sightline.
clips.end_frame: Porch lit, Sơn visible inside but no longer at the window.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Tôi ở đây. Không đi đâu.

clips.lighting: Present-day night, warm cabin lamp inside, cool moonlit pines outside.

cinematic.intent: Make Sơn's response to being watched an offer to be seen rather than another attempt to hide.
cinematic.composition: Use the close-up from the established window side, keeping the closed watch and his face related.
cinematic.blocking: He switches on the porch light, then moves back far enough to be visible inside without standing in the window.
cinematic.performance: His quiet statement sounds addressed to whoever is outside, not a boast of superior awareness.
cinematic.focus: Favor his face and closed lid, allowing the new porch glow to change the background rather than the lens.
cinematic.texture: Warm light finds the weathered frame and jacket shoulder while the watch interior remains concealed.
cinematic.sound_detail: A small switch click and ordinary porch-fixture sound accompany his quietly visible sentence, then pine wind persists.
cinematic.rhythm: Switch, step back and wait form one answer; do not repeatedly scan the tree line or approach the window again.

clips.start_frame: Mây and Thành below the newly lit porch.
clips.action: Mây folds her notebook and orders the suspect approached in daylight.
clips.end_frame: Both moving down the dune path away from the cabin.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Sáng mai hỏi thẳng. Đừng để dân tới gần.

clips.lighting: Present-day night, warm cabin lamp inside, cool moonlit pines outside.

cinematic.intent: Let Mây respond to the offered visibility by choosing timing and public safety, not an impulsive raid.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide view below the porch to hold both officers and the now-lit cabin in a single geography.
cinematic.blocking: She folds the notebook once, gives the instruction and leads Thành down the existing path.
cinematic.performance: Her restraint is an active choice; Thành follows promptly instead of asking a second explanatory question.
cinematic.focus: Keep moving figures and porch light readable without an extra long-lens view through the cabin window.
cinematic.texture: Night sand and pine shadows make their safe descent tangible, with the cabin remaining a steady fixed point.
cinematic.sound_detail: Her line stays low but clear over footsteps shifting on sand; no tactical radio burst is invented.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the instruction finish before the descent carries them away, preserving the porch light as an unresolved last presence.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Mây đang nhìn kẻ bỏ trốn hay người cố để mình được thấy?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Sơn bật đèn cho người quan sát thấy anh không bỏ đi.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Bức ảnh bị úp nhưng chiếc đồng hồ vẫn đóng.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Ánh đèn được dùng như hành vi chấp nhận giám sát, không giả làm tín hiệu bí mật mới.

scenes.title: Rừng Dương
scenes.purpose: Sơn chống phục kích, cứu người sau khi thuốc gây bất động.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Carry the fallen man breathing under the cut to the clinic. No replay of the fall or stretcher arrival.

clips.start_frame: Two marks on the frame, sunlight just reaching the wood.
clips.action: Sơn makes the third mark, hears footsteps and leaves by the rear door.
clips.end_frame: Three marks, rear door moving closed behind him.
clips.lighting: Present-day morning, raking daylight between pines, natural sandy reflections.

cinematic.intent: Turn the familiar morning tally into an alarmed departure without replaying earlier carving beats.
cinematic.composition: The detail setup holds two existing marks and the fresh third, with rear-door direction at the frame edge.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn finishes the third tally, registers approaching footsteps and leaves by the existing rear exit.
cinematic.performance: The tool hand becomes economical, not panicked; the choice of exit should show practiced awareness.
cinematic.focus: Keep the count exact and readable as cuts in wood, without showing pursuers in a second angle.
cinematic.texture: Fresh shavings catch raking light while the rear door moves naturally in the pine breeze.
cinematic.sound_detail: Footsteps arrive over the last short scrape, then the rear latch and retreating step change the sound direction.
cinematic.rhythm: Do not prolong the carving after the threat is heard; the completed mark stays as proof he just left.

clips.start_frame: Empty cabin interior, front door pushed inward by two unnamed men.
clips.action: They search the empty bed and see fresh footprints leading out back.
clips.end_frame: Both intruders turning toward the rear door, cabin otherwise empty.

dialogue.speaker: EXTRA
dialogue.text: Nó vừa ra sau.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning, raking daylight between pines, natural sandy reflections.

cinematic.intent: Let the intruders arrive a beat too late, making the empty cabin itself the suspenseful subject.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide interior setup with front entrance, bed and rear exit all spatially readable.
cinematic.blocking: The two unnamed men search the bed, discover fresh footprints and turn together toward the back.
cinematic.performance: They should be wary and impatient rather than inept; no named lead secretly lingers in the room.
cinematic.focus: Keep the room geography clear, with only enough footprint detail to explain their turn.
cinematic.texture: Rumpled empty bedding and disturbed sand are existing traces, not added weapons, photographs or hidden traps.
cinematic.sound_detail: Front door movement, bed fabric and their short line sit above the wind through the open exit.
cinematic.rhythm: Search briefly, find one direction, then turn; avoid a complete repetitive ransacking montage inside a single clip.

clips.start_frame: One pursuer stepping around a pine, Sơn behind the trunk.
clips.action: Sơn takes his balance and pins his weapon hand without striking his head.
clips.end_frame: Pursuer seated against the trunk, Sơn holding the wrist away.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Bỏ xuống.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning, raking daylight between pines, natural sandy reflections.

cinematic.intent: Show Sơn choosing control over injury, while retaining the physical difficulty of stopping a pursuer.
cinematic.composition: The restrained handheld medium-wide keeps pine trunk, both bodies and the weapon hand readable together.
cinematic.blocking: He uses the trunk-side position to take balance and hold the reaching wrist away from both faces.
cinematic.performance: His breath tightens with effort; the pursuer resists instead of instantly becoming a limp stunt prop.
cinematic.focus: Hold the full defensive relation from one side, with no close-up describing a damaging joint technique.
cinematic.texture: Sand shifts under their feet and rough bark catches clothing, grounding weight without graphic injury.
cinematic.sound_detail: Short breaths, fabric tension and sand displacement replace exaggerated impact booms under his instruction.
cinematic.rhythm: Make contact and controlled descent one short struggle, then keep the restrained posture alive with visible effort.

clips.action: The second pursuer lunges with a fictional Tê applicator, Sơn deflects the arm.
clips.end_frame: Second man stumbling into sand, applicator out of his grasp.
clips.lighting: Present-day morning, raking daylight between pines, natural sandy reflections.

cinematic.intent: Escalate from a controlled restraint to an unpredictable second threat, not a display of effortless mastery.
cinematic.composition: Preserve the same handheld setup, axis and existing body positions at the seam as the second man enters.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn reacts to the new reaching arm while staying aware of the first pursuer, ending with the device out of grasp.
cinematic.performance: Show surprise in his breath and shoulders; the second man overcommits rather than politely waiting for a move.
cinematic.focus: Retain the preceding useful depth and whole-arm readability, without a new device-application close-up or rack.
cinematic.texture: Loose sand and suitless field-jacket fabric carry the abrupt loss of balance through ordinary materials.
cinematic.sound_detail: A scuff, strained exhale and small object landing should dominate; no supernatural pulse announces Tê.
cinematic.rhythm: The new attack interrupts the held control, then the stumble ends the beat without repeating the previous takedown.

clips.start_frame: Second man motionless but visibly breathing, first man still conscious.
clips.action: Sơn checks the fallen man's breathing and calls toward the road for help.
clips.end_frame: Sơn kneeling beside the breathing man, phone at his ear.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Có người cần bác sĩ. Đồi dương.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning, raking daylight between pines, natural sandy reflections.

cinematic.intent: Make the decisive moral action a call for help after the opponent has become vulnerable.
cinematic.composition: The medium view includes Sơn kneeling, the fallen man's breathing torso and the conscious man kept separate.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn checks for visible breathing, keeps his distance from the dropped device and calls toward the known road.
cinematic.performance: His urgency is practical concern rather than guilt performed at camera; he does not admire the result.
cinematic.focus: Keep Sơn's mouth and the breathing patient readable, without graphic medical inspection or instructional detail.
cinematic.texture: Sand clings to clothing and the pine shadows continue moving, preventing the fallen figure from reading as dead.
cinematic.sound_detail: His clear request is close above breath and wind; no pulse monitor or clinic equipment is heard here.
cinematic.rhythm: Give the breathing observation a beat before the call, so care motivates the words rather than following them decoratively.

clips.start_frame: Mây and Thành arriving with a stretcher at the tree line.
clips.action: Sơn steps away with empty hands, Mây takes control of the two men.
clips.end_frame: Mây by the stretcher, Sơn standing where she can see him.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Anh ở lại. Tôi cần nghe hết.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning, raking daylight between pines, natural sandy reflections.

cinematic.intent: End the action on Sơn accepting scrutiny, making cooperation a cost he consciously pays.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide tree-line view to connect stretcher arrival, the two attackers and Sơn's empty hands.
cinematic.blocking: He steps back once to give the stretcher room and stays where Mây can supervise him.
cinematic.performance: Mây's command is firm but not triumphant; Sơn obeys without a defiant stare or another attempted escape.
cinematic.focus: Hold the whole rescue arrangement clear, with no cut to a face that loses the patient positions.
cinematic.texture: Stretcher fabric, sand and field clothing stay practical; the morning sun does not become emergency-colored lighting.
cinematic.sound_detail: Approaching steps and stretcher handling merge with Mây's line, with the breathing thread ready for the clinic cut.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the rescue movement continue while Sơn becomes still by choice, avoiding a victory pose or frozen group tableau.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Sơn sẽ cứu chính người vừa đuổi bắt mình không?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Một pha tự vệ trở thành lựa chọn gọi cứu người và đứng lại.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Dấu chân mới còn dẫn ra cửa sau.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Phản ứng Tê buộc có bác sĩ, đồng thời chứng minh Sơn có thể ngừng ra tay thêm.

scenes.title: Phòng Khám
scenes.purpose: Bác sĩ xác định dấu hiệu Tê, Mây có vật chứng thay vì đoán bằng mặt.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Station radio fades into porch wind. Cut to Mây joining the waiting Sơn and placing her cuffs once.

clips.start_frame: Two attackers on separate beds, one sitting up under supervision.
clips.action: Linh checks the immobile man's breathing while Mây records the time.
clips.end_frame: Linh at bedside, Thành watching the conscious attacker.

dialogue.speaker: LINH
dialogue.text: Còn thở. Chưa được rời mắt.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon, clinic window light with neutral practicals, green curtains.

cinematic.intent: Make care precede interrogation so the clinic scene changes the meaning of the preceding violence.
cinematic.composition: The wide view distinguishes two beds, Linh at the immobile man and Thành watching the conscious one.
cinematic.blocking: Linh stays beside visible breathing while Mây records the observation, keeping access around the bed clear.
cinematic.performance: His line is calm practical attention; Mây absorbs the need for patience rather than demanding instant answers.
cinematic.focus: Keep both patient positions and the observing people legible, without an invented monitor display or intrusive medical close-up.
cinematic.texture: Green curtain folds and worn steel beds give the room lived-in restraint, not a glossy emergency ward.
cinematic.sound_detail: Continue the breathing thread from the dune into quiet ventilation and Linh's measured voice.
cinematic.rhythm: Allow a short observation before the line, then hold ongoing care rather than a dramatic pronouncement of survival.

clips.start_frame: Seized applicator sealed on a tray, Linh beside it.
clips.action: He compares its unusual cap to a reference case photograph he kept.
clips.end_frame: Two matching cap shapes, both separate from the patient.

dialogue.speaker: LINH
dialogue.text: Tôi từng gặp loại Tê này.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon, clinic window light with neutral practicals, green curtains.

cinematic.intent: Make recognition of Tê depend on a remembered physical match, not instant laboratory omniscience.
cinematic.composition: Use the locked detail setup to show sealed device, reference photograph and comparing hand together.
cinematic.blocking: Linh positions the existing photograph beside the sealed object without opening, testing or demonstrating it.
cinematic.performance: His fingers pause at the cap shape with cautious recognition, not certainty about every medical consequence.
cinematic.focus: Keep the two relevant shapes in one clear plane, the patient outside this object-comparison frame.
cinematic.texture: Transparent evidence wrapping slightly dulls the device surface, distinguishing a secured exhibit from something ready to use.
cinematic.sound_detail: A tray touch and photograph scrape sit under the off-screen line; no microscope, scanner or chemical reaction is introduced.
cinematic.rhythm: Compare once, then let the uncertainty remain in the still unopened object for the following explanation.

clips.start_frame: Mây facing Linh beside the closed treatment curtain.
clips.action: He explains that recovery varies and requires monitoring, not an exact timer.
clips.end_frame: Mây crossing out her tentative time estimate.

dialogue.speaker: LINH
dialogue.text: Đừng tin ai hẹn đúng phút tỉnh.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon, clinic window light with neutral practicals, green curtains.

cinematic.intent: Protect future suspense by refusing an exact recovery clock while keeping the doctor useful.
cinematic.composition: Frame Mây and Linh beside the closed curtain, with her note-taking hand visible in the medium shot.
cinematic.blocking: Linh answers without a demonstration; Mây crosses out only her tentative estimate and listens through the rest.
cinematic.performance: His firmness should be weary experience rather than a lecture, and her revision an acceptance of limits.
cinematic.focus: Keep their faces at the same readable depth; the crossed-out note remains a shape rather than an exposed medical number.
cinematic.texture: The green curtain shifts gently beside them while steady practical light keeps skin tones neutral.
cinematic.sound_detail: His measured voice sits over the ordinary clinic bed; do not add a countdown or rising pulse effect.
cinematic.rhythm: Give the warning enough room to be understood, then end on Mây changing the note instead of repeating the rule.

clips.start_frame: Thành beside the conscious attacker, Mây holding the evidence bag.
clips.action: The attacker recognizes the shipping emblem and stops answering.
clips.end_frame: Attacker looking away from the bag, Thành noting the reaction.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Ai đưa các anh tới đây?

clips.lighting: Present-day noon, clinic window light with neutral practicals, green curtains.

cinematic.intent: Let a suspect's silence become evidence of recognition without pretending it is a full confession.
cinematic.composition: Use the medium framing to retain Mây's speaking face, Thành and the conscious attacker within supervised space.
cinematic.blocking: Mây shows the existing bag at the man's eyeline; Thành watches him turn away rather than pushing him upright.
cinematic.performance: Mây asks plainly; the attacker stops answering through a tightened mouth, not a villainous laugh.
cinematic.focus: Keep the questioner and the turning face readable, with the emblem secondary and never legibly lettered.
cinematic.texture: The sealed bag catches plain window light; sheets remain disturbed from treatment, not staged like an interrogation set.
cinematic.sound_detail: A slight wrapping rustle leads into the question, after which the man's withheld answer is allowed to be silent.
cinematic.rhythm: Avoid another forced question in the spare seconds; let Thành's quiet noting of the response close the beat.

clips.start_frame: The conscious attacker off screen, Mây listening without interrupting.
clips.action: He lets slip Sơn's nickname, Mây closes the evidence folder.
clips.end_frame: Mây's closed folder resting against her chest.

dialogue.speaker: EXTRA
dialogue.text: Bóng Ma giữ sổ. Dũng cần sổ.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon, clinic window light with neutral practicals, green curtains.

cinematic.intent: Let an off-screen slip of the nickname redirect Mây toward the person with the ledger.
cinematic.composition: The close-up stays on Mây listening, folder held low enough that its closure is visible.
cinematic.blocking: She hears the slip without interrupting and closes the existing folder only after the important words.
cinematic.performance: Her face narrows into a decision, not a sudden gasp; she does not mouth the off-screen man's sentence.
cinematic.focus: Hold the existing close-up plane on her eyes and speaking-rest mouth, with no reaction insert of the suspect.
cinematic.texture: Plain folder paper and her sun-lined face remain unadorned under the clinic's ordinary light.
cinematic.sound_detail: The suspect's off-screen voice is weak but intelligible, then a single folder closure settles the information.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the voice finish first; her delayed closure makes the finding feel processed rather than announced by a cut.

clips.start_frame: Mây returning to the station, Thành at the support radio.
clips.action: She requests a district team to protect the town and heads up the hill.
clips.end_frame: Thành confirming the support request, Mây leaving with the folder.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Giữ người và vật chứng. Tôi gặp Sơn.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon, clinic window light with neutral practicals, green curtains.

cinematic.intent: Show that seeking Sơn does not mean abandoning the people and evidence already in custody.
cinematic.composition: Frame Mây, Thành, support radio and the departing route in the same medium station setup.
cinematic.blocking: She assigns custody and town protection before taking the folder and leaving toward the hill.
cinematic.performance: Her authority is clear and workmanlike; Thành's acknowledgement should be competent rather than needlessly anxious.
cinematic.focus: Keep her mouth and Thành's radio hand readable, without cutting to an unseen superior or adding another officer portrait.
cinematic.texture: Daylight across the desk and used folder edges retain continuity with this modest station's earlier checks.
cinematic.sound_detail: A quiet radio confirmation follows her assignment, never competing as a second full spoken exchange.
cinematic.rhythm: Finish the practical instruction before the departure, so the scene feels like a completed delegation rather than a cliffhanger trick.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Mây có thể tin điều nào giữa lời đồn Bóng Ma và người còn thở?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Một nghi ngờ về thuốc thành vật chứng, một biệt danh thành người giữ sổ.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Chưa hỏi cung vội khi một bệnh nhân vẫn bất động.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Linh loại bỏ giờ tỉnh chính xác, Mây tách quan sát khỏi kết luận và giữ chứng cứ.

scenes.title: Còng Và Bằng Chứng
scenes.purpose: Sơn đưa bằng chứng kiểm chứng được, Mây nhận ra Hạ qua ảnh rời.
scenes.outgoing_audio: A ferry horn enters while Mây waits for an answer. Cut to Hạ alive at the city pier, not to a second photo reveal.

clips.start_frame: Two tea glasses on the porch table, Sơn already seated.
clips.action: Mây sits opposite and places her cuffs beside her notebook.
clips.end_frame: Cuffs between the glasses, neither person touching them.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Anh là người họ gọi Bóng Ma?

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon porch light, low sun across the table, soft sea fill.

cinematic.intent: Make the negotiation's moral boundary visible before either person asks for trust.
cinematic.composition: The medium table setup holds two tea glasses and space where Mây's cuffs enter between them.
cinematic.blocking: She sits opposite Sơn and places the cuffs once beside her notebook, leaving both untouched afterward.
cinematic.performance: Her question is direct without provocation; Sơn acknowledges the name through attention, not a smug pose.
cinematic.focus: Keep their faces and the object boundary at readable shared depth, with no need for a separate symbolic insert.
cinematic.texture: The cuffs' dull metal and tea-glass warmth coexist on weathered porch wood under the same late sun.
cinematic.sound_detail: The modest cuff contact should be clear but not amplified like a weapon being cocked.
cinematic.rhythm: Place, ask and wait are distinct beats; neither reaches for the cups to manufacture activity during the answer space.

clips.start_frame: Sơn's closed bag on the table, Mây's evidence folder beside it.
clips.action: He removes the black ledger and USB, places both within her reach.
clips.end_frame: Ledger and USB beside Mây's folder, Sơn's hands withdrawn.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Đối chiếu công ty đó với sổ này.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon porch light, low sun across the table, soft sea fill.

cinematic.intent: Let Sơn offer something independently checkable, shifting from evasion toward responsibility.
cinematic.composition: The detail shot keeps his bag, Mây's folder and the arriving ledger and USB physically separate.
cinematic.blocking: He takes both items out, places them within her reach and withdraws his hands instead of guiding hers.
cinematic.performance: Express the risk in the deliberate withdrawal; his off-screen sentence is an invitation to verify, not a demand for belief.
cinematic.focus: Keep the black cover and drive identifiable at one stable plane, without opening an extra screen or revealing readable accounts.
cinematic.texture: Canvas, worn leather and evidence-folder paper have distinct surfaces that preserve each object's origin.
cinematic.sound_detail: Two restrained set-down sounds precede his low line; porch wind continues without a revelation sting.
cinematic.rhythm: Make the offer clean and singular, ending with empty hands outside the evidence area rather than another explanatory tap.

clips.start_frame: Mây checking an entry against the vehicle report.
clips.action: She finds the matching dispatch company, takes a photograph of the page.
clips.end_frame: Mây's phone above the matching entry, Sơn waiting.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Chuyện này tôi sẽ báo lên.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon porch light, low sun across the table, soft sea fill.

cinematic.intent: Give Mây a small verified success before the personal shock arrives, preserving her professional basis for cooperation.
cinematic.composition: Use the medium composition to hold her face, existing vehicle report and the open ledger comparison.
cinematic.blocking: She matches one company entry, photographs that page once and keeps her attention on the evidence.
cinematic.performance: Her line conveys procedure, not a promise of protection; Sơn waits without trying to charm or hurry her.
cinematic.focus: Keep face and page area readable, no legible company name required, and keep the phone screen secondary.
cinematic.texture: Late light across paper grain and the black cover contrasts with the cooler shade under her arm.
cinematic.sound_detail: A soft phone shutter may follow the actual photograph, while her voice remains the clearest sound.
cinematic.rhythm: Let verification precede the sentence so it answers a real discovery rather than simply narrating the hand movement.

clips.action: Sơn agrees to remain available and names the final shipment.
clips.end_frame: Mây writing the deadline, Sơn no longer hiding his bag.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Tôi khai. Nhưng còn người bị giữ.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon porch light, low sun across the table, soft sea fill.

cinematic.intent: Let Sơn accept cooperation but expose the unresolved human stake behind the financial evidence.
cinematic.composition: Preserve the same medium composition, table orientation and focus depth from Mây's verification.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn leaves the bag open and agrees to stay available while Mây notes the final departure.
cinematic.performance: He should sound more exposed when mentioning the held person than when admitting the ledger is his.
cinematic.focus: Keep both eyelines and note-taking hand within the prior useful depth, without a new document insert.
cinematic.texture: The open bag no longer shields the book, creating a subtle material difference from earlier concealment.
cinematic.sound_detail: His line has room above porch wind; Mây's writing begins after the key admission instead of scratching through it.
cinematic.rhythm: End on her recording the deadline and his cessation of concealment, not on another attempt to explain the same shipping schedule.

clips.start_frame: Sơn sliding Hạ's loose photograph across the table.
clips.action: Mây recognizes the face and holds the photograph by its white edge.
clips.end_frame: Hạ's loose portrait in Mây's hand, watch nowhere opened.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Hạ. Bạn hồi nhỏ của tôi.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon porch light, low sun across the table, soft sea fill.

cinematic.intent: Make Mây's recognition land through touch and hesitation while keeping the watch's future reveal intact.
cinematic.composition: Use the detail frame on the loose portrait crossing wood into Mây's hand, separate from any silver case.
cinematic.blocking: She catches only the white photograph edge, stopping the slide without covering Hạ's face.
cinematic.performance: Her fingers momentarily firm at the edge; the off-screen recognition is quieter than a shouted shock.
cinematic.focus: Keep the printed face and holding fingertips at one plane, never spawning Hạ physically beside the table.
cinematic.texture: The portrait's worn white border and matte surface distinguish it from a glowing phone or watch interior.
cinematic.sound_detail: Paper drag stops abruptly enough to register, then the short name lands against continuous sea wind.
cinematic.rhythm: Let her hand stop the photograph before the name comes; avoid a second photograph pass or an added flashback inside this clip.

clips.start_frame: Mây looking up from the photograph at Sơn.
clips.action: She asks where Hạ is, Sơn has to hold her gaze.
clips.end_frame: Mây waiting, Sơn unable to lower his eyes.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Anh kể từ đầu.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon porch light, low sun across the table, soft sea fill.

cinematic.intent: Turn professional cooperation into personal accountability without letting either person escape the moment.
cinematic.composition: The close-up favors Mây's visible speaking face, with Sơn only as the established near edge or receiving profile.
cinematic.blocking: She lifts her gaze from the loose photograph and waits for Sơn to meet it.
cinematic.performance: The question carries restrained hurt rather than immediate tears; his refusal to look away is the answer before words.
cinematic.focus: Keep Mây's eyes and mouth clear, with no sudden rack to the portrait or a second close-up of Sơn.
cinematic.texture: Late porch light remains unchanged, refusing to turn the discovery into an artificial lighting event.
cinematic.sound_detail: Her concise instruction is followed by unfilled wind and breath, no music instructing the audience to grieve.
cinematic.rhythm: Stay longer on the held gaze after the line than on the line itself, then let the past answer through the next cut.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Mây có thể hợp tác với một người biết chuyện Hạ mà không bỏ luật?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Chứng cứ tạo hợp tác, ảnh rời biến vụ án thành chuyện của chính Mây.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Hai vật có thể còng người và chứng minh lời nói nằm giữa hai ly trà.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Không mở đồng hồ để gây nhận diện; cú thấy ảnh cần im đủ lâu trước câu hỏi tiếp.

scenes.title: Quá Khứ: Đường Về
scenes.purpose: Hạ gieo kiến thức hải đăng và mục tiêu mở sạp hoa.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Retain the city ferry horn briefly over the coastal lighthouse entrance, then change to local wind.

clips.start_frame: Hạ walking along the city pier, Sơn beside her.
clips.action: She stops at a ferry's distant light and names her home town.
clips.end_frame: Both facing the water, ferry light far beyond.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.text: Hòn Sóng. Nhà em ở đó.

clips.lighting: Recent-past evening city pier, warm lamps and last daylight, no hard neon.

cinematic.intent: Let Hạ introduce her own home as a desired future, not simply information Sơn will later use.
cinematic.composition: The wide pier view gives both walkers and the distant ferry one shared direction across open water.
cinematic.blocking: She stops at the rail to name the town; he stops because she does, not because of a target.
cinematic.performance: Her tone warms at the name, while his attention turns from the ferry toward her face.
cinematic.focus: Keep the two figures and ferry light readable at wide depth without a separate scenic insert.
cinematic.texture: Warm pier lamps meet the last daylight, leaving ordinary rail wear and water movement visible.
cinematic.sound_detail: A low ferry horn stays distant enough to support, not overwhelm, her simple naming of home.
cinematic.rhythm: Allow walking to settle before the name, letting the pause feel like memory rather than a forced plot clue.

clips.start_frame: Hạ drawing a round tower in condensation on a railing panel.
clips.action: She sketches a small maintenance hatch below the gallery.
clips.end_frame: Her fingertip at the hatch sketch, Sơn watching.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.text: Ba em giữ đèn. Em thuộc từng cửa.

clips.lighting: Recent-past evening city pier, warm lamps and last daylight, no hard neon.

cinematic.intent: Make knowledge of the lighthouse arise from a child's familiarity with a parent's work.
cinematic.composition: The medium composition keeps Hạ's face and the existing misted glass panel within the same reach.
cinematic.blocking: She draws the rough tower and hatch from habit while Sơn follows her finger, no blueprint performance.
cinematic.performance: Her ease should be affectionate and slightly amused at the specificity; he listens without treating it as tactical briefing.
cinematic.focus: Keep the finger sketch and faces within useful medium depth, never changing to a revealing macro map.
cinematic.texture: Moisture smears under her fingertip, making the rough little hatch imperfect and temporary rather than diagrammatically precise.
cinematic.sound_detail: A soft fingertip drag and open-air water bed support her voice, with no ominous clue emphasis.
cinematic.rhythm: Let her drawing accompany the sentence, then stop before adding unnecessary arrows, routes or an invented floor plan.

clips.action: Sơn asks about the sea, she points to the town in an old photo.
clips.end_frame: Old lighthouse photo held between them, maintenance hatch visible.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.text: Mất điện vẫn có đèn dự phòng.

clips.lighting: Recent-past evening city pier, warm lamps and last daylight, no hard neon.

cinematic.intent: Give the memory a real family object while keeping the future rescue knowledge secondary to intimacy.
cinematic.composition: Hold the exact medium setup and established glass-panel relation as the existing photograph enters the shared plane.
cinematic.blocking: Hạ brings the old lighthouse photo between them near the earlier sketch, Sơn remaining beside her.
cinematic.performance: She speaks from familiarity, not as if foreshadowing danger; his quiet attention shows respect for her ordinary history.
cinematic.focus: Retain the prior depth and face readability, letting the photo stay recognizable without a new sharp foreground rack.
cinematic.texture: The small photograph has worn edges and muted color, unlike the wet temporary finger sketch behind it.
cinematic.sound_detail: Paper handling is slight beneath her line; the ferry and water remain at the same distance as before.
cinematic.rhythm: The new photo completes the thought once, then leaves room for her actual wish rather than dwelling on the hatch.

clips.action: Hạ puts the photograph away and names the life she wants.
clips.end_frame: Her empty hands resting on the rail, Sơn beside her.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.text: Em muốn mở sạp hoa cạnh chợ cá.

clips.lighting: Recent-past evening city pier, warm lamps and last daylight, no hard neon.

cinematic.intent: Let Hạ name a life she wants for herself, giving her more than a role as Sơn's escape fantasy.
cinematic.composition: Keep the same medium composition and focus plane while the photograph is put away within existing reach.
cinematic.blocking: She pockets the photograph and rests both empty hands on the rail, facing the town's imagined direction.
cinematic.performance: Her wish sounds modest and practical, with a small trace of pleasure at describing it aloud.
cinematic.focus: Maintain the same readable faces and hands, without a scenic cutaway illustrating a shop that does not yet exist.
cinematic.texture: Her pale scarf and worn rail catch soft light; the open hands replace the earlier information-bearing photo.
cinematic.sound_detail: Her sentence stays close against ordinary harbour sound, avoiding a sentimental swell that turns the wish into a prophecy.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the practical words finish before she looks at Sơn, giving him a chance to meet the life she has described.

clips.start_frame: Hạ with her pale-blue scarf loose at her neck.
clips.action: Wind lifts one end, Sơn catches it before it touches dirty water.
clips.end_frame: Scarf back in Hạ's hand, his gloved hand released.
clips.lighting: Recent-past evening city pier, warm lamps and last daylight, no hard neon.

cinematic.intent: Make a small protective reflex intimate without confusing it with ownership of the scarf.
cinematic.composition: The close-up holds Hạ's face, the loose scarf end and Sơn's gloved hand within one plausible reach.
cinematic.blocking: Wind lifts the existing scarf; Sơn catches its end and returns the cloth to her hand immediately.
cinematic.performance: He is gentle without lingering possession, and her brief look acknowledges care rather than helplessness.
cinematic.focus: Keep the caught fabric and faces at useful close-up depth, never making the water an impossible sharp insert.
cinematic.texture: Blue silk moves lightly against black glove, its intact edge clear before the later torn-fragment scenes.
cinematic.sound_detail: Use fabric movement over the steady pier wind, not a splash or dramatic catch sound that did not occur.
cinematic.rhythm: The catch is quick and the release unforced; let the moment after he lets go carry the intimacy.

clips.start_frame: The two standing at the pier rail, a ship horn beginning.
clips.action: Hạ starts walking back, Sơn chooses to follow her instead of the ferry.
clips.end_frame: Both leaving left to right, open water behind.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Bạn em còn giữ chỗ đó không?

clips.lighting: Recent-past evening city pier, warm lamps and last daylight, no hard neon.

cinematic.intent: End the memory on Sơn following a person's chosen direction instead of the working route in front of him.
cinematic.composition: The wide pier setup keeps the rail, ferry direction and their left-to-right walking path easy to read.
cinematic.blocking: Hạ leaves first along the existing walkway; Sơn chooses to follow after one brief hesitation.
cinematic.performance: His question should carry tentative interest in belonging, not a polished romantic line; she need not add a reply.
cinematic.focus: Keep both moving figures in the established wide depth, preserving departure direction without an extra face insert.
cinematic.texture: Water remains open behind them as their bodies leave the rail, warm pier lamps staying consistent.
cinematic.sound_detail: The ferry horn begins at its real distance and can carry the edit, while footsteps remain light and ordinary.
cinematic.rhythm: Give the hesitation less time than the choice, ending on shared forward movement rather than another farewell pose.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Hạ thật sự muốn cùng Sơn đi đâu nếu anh không còn làm nghề?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Cô nói một đời sống cụ thể và chủ động kéo anh khỏi hướng chuyến tàu.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Ở bến xa quê, cô tả cửa về chứ không kể định mệnh.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Cửa kỹ thuật và đèn dự phòng gieo hữu cơ qua nghề của cha, trả ở 45–51.

scenes.title: Hải Đăng Và Một Câu Hỏi
scenes.purpose: Mây tìm chứng cứ sống và kiểm tra lối kỹ thuật trước cao trào.
scenes.outgoing_audio: The clipped service key settles, incoming station fan introduces the USB desk. Do not replay the backup-lamp test.

clips.start_frame: Mây unlocking the lighthouse's lower iron door, Sơn behind her.
clips.action: She shows him the old service route and starts up the stairs.
clips.end_frame: Main door open, service hatch visible beside the stair base.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Hạ lớn lên ở đây.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon at sea cliff, fading daylight, lamp only during its deliberate test.

cinematic.intent: Make returning to Hạ's real place shift the investigation from stories to physical geography.
cinematic.composition: The wide entrance view connects main door, first stair section and visible service route in one understandable arrangement.
cinematic.blocking: Mây opens the lower door with the existing key, steps through and lets Sơn follow toward the stairs.
cinematic.performance: She moves with local familiarity rather than performing a tour; his pace is attentive, not nostalgic ownership.
cinematic.focus: Keep both bodies and door relationships legible, without compressing the route into disconnected architectural inserts.
cinematic.texture: Rusted paint, worn stair edges and sea-blown grass mark a used public building, not a mystical ruin.
cinematic.sound_detail: Key and iron latch introduce the local wind; the sentence stays practical above the threshold sound.
cinematic.rhythm: Finish entry and direction before the next gallery shot, leaving the door open where the endpoint requires it.

clips.start_frame: Both on the gallery, facing the houses below.
clips.action: Mây identifies Hạ's family home without romanticizing Sơn's account.
clips.end_frame: Mây pointing down to the house, Sơn facing her.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Tôi chưa thấy nó về gần tháng.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon at sea cliff, fading daylight, lamp only during its deliberate test.

cinematic.intent: Let Mây place Hạ's absence inside a real home and a real friendship, not just Sơn's grief.
cinematic.composition: Use the medium gallery view to include both faces and her pointing direction toward the harbour houses.
cinematic.blocking: Mây identifies the house once while staying on her side of the rail, then looks back toward Sơn.
cinematic.performance: Her tone is matter-of-fact with held concern; his reaction should not claim he knows Hạ's home better than she does.
cinematic.focus: Keep faces primary and the house direction contextual, avoiding an impossible readable close-up of a distant address.
cinematic.texture: Salt-worn rail and low evening light hold the same coastal world, with no new memorial objects.
cinematic.sound_detail: Wind remains present but controlled under her short factual line, with distant harbour sound barely defined.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the pointing gesture establish the fact, then spend the remainder on what the unanswered absence means between them.

clips.action: Sơn admits he has only a threat and a torn piece of cloth.
clips.end_frame: Mây looking directly at him, Sơn's hands empty on the rail.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Tôi tưởng họ đã giết cô ấy.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon at sea cliff, fading daylight, lamp only during its deliberate test.

cinematic.intent: Let Sơn state an assumption as his own fear rather than establishing Hạ's death as objective truth.
cinematic.composition: Preserve the preceding medium setup, gallery positions and focus while the pointing hand lowers naturally.
cinematic.blocking: He admits what he believed, hands empty on the rail, leaving Mây room to test it.
cinematic.performance: His voice should be reluctant and ashamed, not a definitive narrator's verdict; she listens without accepting the premise.
cinematic.focus: Hold the same face-and-rail plane, keeping his unarmed hands readable without introducing a separate symbolic insert.
cinematic.texture: The rough rail presses into bare palms while wind moves the jacket, maintaining ordinary physical presence.
cinematic.sound_detail: Leave a breath before the admission and no graveyard-like musical punctuation after the word describing his fear.
cinematic.rhythm: The admission slows the scene briefly, but its incompleteness should invite Mây's next practical question immediately.

clips.action: Mây refuses the assumption and asks for verifiable contact details.
clips.end_frame: Sơn offering the phone, Mây taking it.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Chưa có chứng cứ. Ta tìm người sống.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon at sea cliff, fading daylight, lamp only during its deliberate test.

cinematic.intent: Make Mây's refusal of an unsupported conclusion feel like an act of care grounded in evidence.
cinematic.composition: Retain the same medium camera, eyelines and depth at the continuation seam; do not reframe for an inspirational speech.
cinematic.blocking: She asks for contact evidence, and Sơn offers the existing phone into her hand without resistance.
cinematic.performance: Her line is firm and steady, carrying hope through a practical verb; his release of the phone accepts her method.
cinematic.focus: Keep both faces and the modest handover inside the established plane, without reading the phone screen.
cinematic.texture: The ordinary phone sits briefly against weathered rail and khaki sleeve, not a glowing new clue display.
cinematic.sound_detail: Her short sentence rises clearly above wind; a soft phone-to-palm contact closes the beat.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Hai mảnh khớp có đủ chứng minh Hạ còn sống không?

scenes.title: Lời Mời Không Tên
scenes.purpose: Người môi giới chứng minh biết Hạ và muốn Sơn phục vụ kế hoạch riêng.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Keep the same departing coach engine into the on-board view. No second boarding or repeat door close.

clips.start_frame: Phone answered in Sơn's hand, Mây beside him at the table.

clips.end_frame: Two phones apart on the table, both listening.

dialogue.text: Hạ vẫn giữ cái kẹp tóc màu bạc.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon, warm low sun across porch, dusk at coach stop.

cinematic.intent: Make the caller's access to a personal detail unsettle Sơn while Mây preserves room for doubt.

cinematic.focus: Keep faces and the two device positions readable without a fabricated caller image or legible recording waveform.
cinematic.texture: Ordinary worn phone surfaces and porch wood contrast with the emotional weight of the voice.
cinematic.sound_detail: The filtered caller sounds human and controlled, not electronically monstrous; wind stays low beneath the private detail.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the detail arrive before either person reacts, then hold the separate phones to preserve their different functions.

clips.start_frame: Sơn listening without touching either phone.
clips.action: The private detail makes him lean forward despite himself.
clips.end_frame: Sơn's expression changed, Mây noticing the change.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Anh gặp cô ấy ở đâu?

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon, warm low sun across porch, dusk at coach stop.

cinematic.intent: Expose the hope Sơn cannot suppress without letting it become certainty that Hạ is alive.
cinematic.composition: Use the close-up on his listening face, with Mây still in the established surrounding space.

cinematic.performance: His eyes sharpen before the voice changes; the question should reveal need that he would prefer to hide.
cinematic.focus: Hold the current facial plane, avoiding a rack to Mây or an invented inset of the hair clip.
cinematic.texture: Wind moves a lapel edge while his hands stay outside the device area, keeping vulnerability in the face.
cinematic.sound_detail: A short intake of breath precedes his line; the caller's channel remains present but does not overlap as a second sentence.
cinematic.rhythm: Give the personal reaction a fraction before the question, then leave the unanswered space audible.

clips.end_frame: Sơn looking toward his bag, recorder still running.

dialogue.speaker: BROKER
dialogue.text: Lấy sổ đỏ. Tôi cho anh thấy cô ấy.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon, warm low sun across porch, dusk at coach stop.

cinematic.intent: Let the caller convert that hope into an assignment, making manipulation legible in the same held reaction.

cinematic.performance: His expression should close slightly as he recognizes the steering; do not add a new shocked response.
cinematic.focus: Retain the previous face plane and peripheral device relationship, without a new safe image or ledger flashback.
cinematic.texture: The same porch light and jacket texture remain unchanged, so the power shift comes from his listening.
cinematic.sound_detail: The compressed voice stays smooth and unhurried; the recording phone must not emit a distracting notification.
cinematic.rhythm: Allow the instruction to finish before the bag glance, making that movement a response rather than a repeated search.

clips.start_frame: Mây holding the recorder steady beside Sơn.

clips.end_frame: Sơn's hand hovering over the end-call button.

dialogue.speaker: MAY_C
dialogue.text: Đừng nhận thêm điều kiện.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon, warm low sun across porch, dusk at coach stop.

cinematic.intent: Give Mây a visible intervention before Sơn can be drawn into a new bargain.

cinematic.blocking: She keeps recording and gives the short warning, Sơn's hand moving only toward the end-call control.
cinematic.performance: Her tone is low and firm rather than an order shouted over him; he hears the practical boundary.
cinematic.focus: Keep her mouth and his hovering hand readable at one depth, without a new phone-screen close-up.
cinematic.texture: Two ordinary devices and the bag retain their fixed positions, preventing props from becoming a visual shell game.
cinematic.sound_detail: Her words sit cleanly above the line's quiet room noise; no suspense pulse needs to announce good judgment.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the warning complete before his hand reaches the control, leaving the actual decision to the next continuous beat.

clips.action: Sơn demands proof of life before discussing any other job.
clips.end_frame: His hand ends the call rather than waiting for permission.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Cho tôi thấy Hạ còn sống trước.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon, warm low sun across porch, dusk at coach stop.

cinematic.intent: Let Sơn reclaim the terms by demanding evidence and ending contact himself.

cinematic.texture: The phone remains an ordinary object after the line ends, not a glowing symbol under changed light.
cinematic.sound_detail: The channel cuts cleanly after his demand, restoring exposed porch wind rather than an electronic menace tone.
cinematic.rhythm: Hold a short living silence after disconnection, so the choice lands without repeating the warning or bargaining again.

clips.start_frame: Night coach approaching the town stop, both travelers waiting.

clips.end_frame: Coach door closing, Thành remaining in town.

cinematic.texture: Coach door wear, packed bags and ordinary road dust connect the departure to the opening arrival without copying it.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Người gọi biết Hạ hay chỉ biết cách khiến Sơn làm theo?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Sơn đòi bằng chứng sống và tự ngắt cuộc mặc cả đầu tiên.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Một chi tiết riêng tư làm thay đổi hơi thở người nghe, không lộ mặt người gọi.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Video 27 sẽ trả điều kiện này; hai điện thoại giữ chức năng nghe và ghi khác nhau.

scenes.title: Xe Đò Đêm
scenes.purpose: Hai người vào thành phố với trạng thái trang phục rõ.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Coach-window rain becomes rain on the silk-shop rear awning. The city arrival is a time ellipsis, not another travel montage.

clips.start_frame: Sơn seated by the coach window, Mây across the narrow aisle.

clips.end_frame: Patrol message acknowledged, folded black suit visible in the bag.

cinematic.intent: Place private dread beside Mây's still-active responsibility for the town.

cinematic.blocking: Both remain seated through the coach sway; Sơn opens the bag without crossing toward her.
cinematic.performance: Mây reads efficiently then checks him, while Sơn avoids seeking permission for the suit.
cinematic.focus: Keep the suit reveal secondary until her patrol acknowledgement has registered.
cinematic.texture: Rain tracks outside, worn canvas and damp denim make this practical travel.
cinematic.sound_detail: Maintain steady engine, soft rain and one small bag-clasp sound, without a suspense sting.
cinematic.rhythm: Confirmation first, folded suit last; let that new object change the silence.

clips.start_frame: Black suit folded across Sơn's knees, gloves tucked inside.
clips.action: He touches the gloves, Mây keeps her attention on his face.
clips.end_frame: Gloves still folded, Sơn's hand withdrawn.

dialogue.speaker: MAY_C
dialogue.text: Anh vẫn cần bộ đó sao?

clips.lighting: Present-day night journey, blue coach practicals, neutral rest-stop lamps, no past amber timeline cue.

cinematic.blocking: His fingertips touch only the glove edge, then withdraw to the same lap position.
cinematic.performance: Mây asks without accusation; Sơn's response is a controlled swallow rather than a dramatic flinch.
cinematic.focus: Keep both people and gloves readable in the existing medium shot, no rack to another angle.
cinematic.texture: The supple dark leather contrasts with her rain-marked denim and his rough canvas bag.
cinematic.sound_detail: His line must not compete with cloth movement or an artificially amplified heartbeat.
cinematic.rhythm: Leave the question hanging after his hand leaves, allowing recognition rather than explanation.

clips.action: Sơn returns the folded suit and gloves from his knees into the open bag, closes it and speaks about his first employer without a full flashback.
clips.end_frame: Bag closed between his feet, Mây listening.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Bà cho tôi chỗ ở. Rồi giữ luôn lối ra.

clips.lighting: Present-day night journey, blue coach practicals, neutral rest-stop lamps, no past amber timeline cue.

cinematic.intent: Show that admitting dependency costs Sơn more than touching the old uniform.
cinematic.composition: Retain exactly the preceding medium composition, aisle width and seated eyelines.
cinematic.blocking: He returns the folded suit and gloves to the open bag, closes it, then lowers it between his feet.
cinematic.performance: Say the sentence as an unwelcome fact he has only just permitted himself to name.
cinematic.focus: Keep attention on his face while her listening remains visible at the same depth.
cinematic.texture: The bag's worn corners settle against his shoes, underlining years of carrying this life.
cinematic.sound_detail: Let the bag close sound finish before the quieter final clause is heard.
cinematic.rhythm: The first clause acknowledges shelter; the second arrives after a small embarrassed breath.

clips.start_frame: Coach stopped under a rest-stop awning, travelers already outside.
clips.action: Sơn walks toward the changing room, Mây waits beside the coach.
clips.end_frame: Mây beside the coach door, Sơn beyond the changing-room entrance.
clips.lighting: Present-day night journey, blue coach practicals, neutral rest-stop lamps, no past amber timeline cue.

cinematic.intent: Separate the decision to change clothes from a glamorous transformation montage.

cinematic.blocking: Sơn walks directly under the awning; she holds her station near the coach door.
cinematic.performance: She watches him go as a partner assessing risk, not as an admirer of his profession.
cinematic.focus: Hold the whole route legible; do not follow him into the changing room inside this take.
cinematic.texture: Wet paving reflects ordinary rest-stop lamps, with rain falling beyond the sheltered path.
cinematic.sound_detail: Idling engine continues, footsteps briefly sharpen under the roof, no heroic music rise.
cinematic.rhythm: Let his exit from her immediate reach create the small uncertainty before the cut.

clips.start_frame: Sơn before the mirror, suit already on and gloves in his hand.

clips.end_frame: Sơn in black suit with bare hands, olive jacket folded in his bag.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Tôi mặc lại vest. Không mang lại đôi tay cũ.

clips.lighting: Present-day night journey, blue coach practicals, neutral rest-stop lamps, no past amber timeline cue.

cinematic.intent: Define his change through a missing glove rather than the attractiveness of the suit.
cinematic.composition: Use the existing mirror to include his direct shoulder and one reflected face, not twin bodies.
cinematic.blocking: He pockets the gloves once; both bare hands finish visible below the jacket edge.
cinematic.performance: He inspects himself with guarded fatigue, avoiding a triumphant straightening of his shoulders.
cinematic.focus: Keep the reflected eyes sharp enough to read while the folded olive jacket remains identifiable.
cinematic.texture: Cold rest-room tile and a plain mirror deny the costume change any luxury.
cinematic.sound_detail: Narration sits over muffled engine and a slight leather rustle, with no added ticking.
cinematic.rhythm: Pause only long enough to register the bare hands after the gloves disappear.

clips.start_frame: Mây holding the coach door open, Sơn returning with his bag.
clips.action: They reboard, Sơn puts the bag above his seat.
clips.end_frame: Both back on the coach, olive jacket stored inside the bag.
clips.lighting: Present-day night journey, blue coach practicals, neutral rest-stop lamps, no past amber timeline cue.

cinematic.intent: Return the changed man to the same ordinary journey without repeating his arrival.
cinematic.composition: Anchor the coach doorway and Mây outside it, preserving his approach direction from the room.
cinematic.blocking: He comes back carrying the bag, boards after her, and stows it once overhead.
cinematic.performance: Mây recognizes the change with a restrained look, then makes room rather than commenting.
cinematic.focus: Keep his hands and the overhead bag placement readable within the existing wide setup.
cinematic.texture: The olive jacket stays contained in canvas, while rain beads on the bus exterior.
cinematic.sound_detail: Keep the same engine character and coach-door mechanisms, not a fresh engine start.
cinematic.rhythm: Complete reboarding economically; the stowed bag is the quiet confirmation that the change holds.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Anh có thể mặc lại bộ đồ cũ mà không quay về con người cũ không?

dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Gieo tay trần và chiếc túi sẽ được để lại ở cảnh35.

scenes.title: Két Sau Bình Phong
scenes.purpose: Lấy khóa số và sổ đỏ, Bà Hai chủ động giữ họ lại.

clips.start_frame: Sơn and Mây at the closed rear door in the rain.

clips.end_frame: Rear door opening inward, both travelers at the threshold.

dialogue.speaker: SON_S
dialogue.text: Chìa cửa cũ. Tôi giữ hai mươi lăm năm.

cinematic.focus: The doorway and their faces share useful depth; no insert or extra close-up is needed.
cinematic.texture: Rain darkens old wood beneath the shallow awning, with no newly invented sign or lock.
cinematic.sound_detail: Give the old key turn a modest audible click beneath his short explanation.
cinematic.rhythm: Do not stretch the unlocking; the easy opening should create the more troubling question.

clips.start_frame: Both inside the dim shop, rear door behind screen left.

clips.end_frame: Screen pulled aside, safe in front of Sơn, Mây by the exit.

cinematic.blocking: Sơn leads without searching; Mây keeps a clear route back to the rear exit.

cinematic.focus: Keep the safe screen readable ahead of him, not a sudden focus reveal behind their backs.
cinematic.texture: Silk brushes close to the frame, narrowing the path without becoming dreamlike curtains.
cinematic.sound_detail: Soft shoe steps, rain outside and a single cloth brush carry the intrusion.
cinematic.rhythm: Let familiarity make the approach efficient; the waiting safe is the final image of confidence.

clips.start_frame: Safe open, red ledger and USB-shaped hardware token inside.

cinematic.blocking: His right hand takes the token, left arm receives the book, no rummaging through unrelated valuables.
cinematic.performance: Hands remain businesslike, stopping briefly at the token to verify it is the needed object.

cinematic.texture: Steel safe edge, red cloth wear and token shape provide specific visual separation.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC
dialogue.text: Má để cửa cho con.

cinematic.composition: Hold all three positions in the wide shot, safe behind Sơn and lit desk behind the turn.
cinematic.blocking: Both travelers turn toward the desk without advancing, leaving Mây aligned with the rear exit.
cinematic.performance: Bà Hai is already settled, greeting them softly; their delayed recognition supplies the shock.

cinematic.sound_detail: Lamp switch first, then her voice; do not accompany the reveal with a generic sting.
cinematic.rhythm: Allow one beat to identify her before the greeting, then hold the unequal stillness.

cinematic.composition: Frame Bà Hai's open palms with Sơn retaining the red ledger, Mây still near the exit.

cinematic.performance: Her offer should sound maternal on the surface and commercially exact underneath.
cinematic.focus: Keep ledger and her eyes sufficiently readable to show where her interest has moved.
cinematic.texture: The polished desk separates her domestic hospitality from the safe standing open behind them.
cinematic.sound_detail: Let her low offer remain dry against the room tone, without swelling threat music.

dialogue.speaker: SON_S
dialogue.text: Hạ ở đâu?

cinematic.blocking: He draws the chair away at an angle toward escape; Mây never takes the spare place.
cinematic.performance: His question strips courtesy away, while Bà Hai lets the empty seat remain a rebuke.
cinematic.focus: Keep his face and the unused cup visible; do not cut to isolated furniture.
cinematic.texture: Chair feet catch lightly on the shop floor, three tea surfaces remain undisturbed.
cinematic.sound_detail: Allow a modest chair scrape before the question, with no duplicate cup-setting sounds.
cinematic.rhythm: The chair movement creates expectation of sitting; the unanswered question defeats it instead.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Bà Hai thực sự bị đột nhập hay đang dẫn họ vào cuộc trao đổi?

dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Sổ đỏ và token có đường ra rõ, còn Bà Hai chủ động khóa đường tâm lý.

dialogue.text: Kiên trả tiền để con im miệng.

cinematic.performance: The word naming Hạ carries effort; he avoids anger performed as shouting or clenched teeth.
cinematic.focus: Keep his eyes sharp, with Bà Hai's lowered cup a contextual softness rather than a second target.
cinematic.texture: Rain-dark suit cloth and bare knuckles carry his vulnerability without sweat added for effect.
cinematic.sound_detail: Let the simple question interrupt the tea ritual, leaving the room immediately quiet afterward.
cinematic.rhythm: A short held look before speech, then enough space for the refusal of her terms.

dialogue.text: Má không giết. Má bán.

dramaturgy.turn_vi: Mây giữ được mẫu nguyên niêm phong, đường xuống sông biến thành lối thoát thật.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Ống thông gió cho nhìn thấy thứ trong sổ đang tồn tại ngoài đời.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Đường sông dẫn sang video của Hạ, tránh thêm một cuộc rượt vô nghĩa.

scenes.title: Hạ Trong Khung Hình
scenes.purpose: Hạ gửi manh mối bằng hành động trong video, xác nhận còn sống.
scenes.outgoing_audio: River wind bridges into corridor rain in the distant memory. Do not bring back phone-video fan noise after that video has ended.

clips.start_frame: Both travelers in the boat, factory now distant behind them.
clips.action: The unknown caller sends a short video, Sơn reduces the engine noise.
clips.end_frame: Phone angled between both travelers, boat idling in open water.

dialogue.speaker: BROKER
dialogue.text: Anh đòi thấy. Đây.

clips.lighting: Present-day dusk on river, muted sunset outside, neutral bright room only inside the received video.

cinematic.intent: Make receiving Hạ's image interrupt an escape that had briefly found a rhythm.
cinematic.composition: Keep the phone between both travelers, boat space and receding shore still recognizable.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn reduces the engine noise before they angle the received image toward both faces.
cinematic.performance: His urgency shows through careful handling, while Mây waits rather than grabbing the phone.
cinematic.focus: Their listening and shared device remain primary, with no floating screen or caller body.
cinematic.texture: Dusk light is softer on their travel-worn clothes, water still moving behind them.
cinematic.sound_detail: The motor drops naturally, allowing the filtered caller to enter without a music change.
cinematic.rhythm: Reduction of noise comes first, anticipation second, received proof last.

clips.start_frame: Hạ alone in a plain bright room, camera at her eye level.
clips.action: She says Sơn's name and deliberately turns her hair clip toward the ventilation window.
clips.end_frame: Silver clip held beside a small fan with a ferry emblem beyond it.

dialogue.speaker: HA_D
dialogue.text: Sơn. Em còn đây.

clips.lighting: Present-day dusk on river, muted sunset outside, neutral bright room only inside the received video.

cinematic.intent: Let Hạ use the forced recording as an opportunity to send her own information.
