cinematic.rhythm: Let the car genuinely clear the immediate space before attention returns to the folder left there.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Kiên có thực sự cho Sơn thấy Hạ mà vẫn giữ được quyền định đoạt cô không?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Hạ khẳng định tự đi được, Kiên biến cuộc trao đổi thành yêu cầu nhận tội thay.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Xe trắng tới nơi Sơn đã chọn nhìn biển, xâm phạm khoảng yên mới có.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Cửa xe và tay nắm trở thành thước đo quyền tự do của Hạ, dẫn tới vạch an toàn ở cảng.

scenes.title: Điều Kiện Không Đổi
scenes.purpose: Mây và Sơn điều chỉnh kế theo điều kiện mới, không kể lại kế cũ.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Match present Sơn bare hand holding the copy to young Sơn empty palms under the awning. No glove-box reveal until 38.4.

clips.start_frame: Mây and Sơn behind the stall with the unopened confession folder.
clips.action: Mây identifies the new trap, Sơn agrees the folder will remain blank.
clips.end_frame: Folder closed in Mây's hand, Sơn's hands empty.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Hắn cần người nhận tội thay.

clips.lighting: Same afternoon as scene 36, quiet shade behind awning.

cinematic.intent: Give Mây the uncomfortable task of naming what Sơn's urgency might make him accept.
cinematic.composition: Keep both partners behind the stall with the unopened folder occupying their shared table edge.
cinematic.blocking: Mây takes custody of the folder, Sơn leaves his hands empty instead of arguing for a shortcut.
cinematic.performance: She is direct without scolding; he recognizes the trap but must feel the price of resisting it.
cinematic.focus: Keep her face and the closed folder readable, avoiding an extra close-up of imagined written terms.
cinematic.texture: Awning shade removes the white car's glare, leaving ordinary paper between two tired people.
cinematic.sound_detail: The receding engine can fade under her line, then only canvas and distant stall activity remain.
cinematic.rhythm: Name the trap once, ending on custody of the folder rather than another explanation of Kiên.

clips.start_frame: Copy envelope open between them, only selected ledger pages inside.
clips.action: They mark it as a preview, originals already with the investigator.
clips.end_frame: Preview pages separated from the blank confession folder.

dialogue.speaker: SON_S
dialogue.text: Tôi chỉ đưa bản xem trước.

clips.lighting: Same afternoon as scene 36, quiet shade behind awning.

cinematic.intent: Separate the limited preview they will offer from the false admission they will never sign.
cinematic.composition: Use the detail frame to show the open copy envelope and closed confession folder apart.
cinematic.blocking: They verify the selected pages already present, keeping originals absent and the folder untouched.
cinematic.performance: Their hands communicate agreement through clear separation, not a staged secret-agent flourish.
cinematic.focus: Keep paper thickness and different containers legible, with no readable signatures or invented security marks.
cinematic.texture: Thin preview sheets and the heavier folder create a concrete visual distinction.
cinematic.sound_detail: Paper edges moving against the table support Sơn's off-screen sentence, with no digital confirmation sound.
cinematic.rhythm: Finish with preview and confession separated, making the refusal visible without rehearsing the whole exchange.

clips.start_frame: Mây beside the confirmed road map, Sơn looking toward the harbour.
clips.action: Mây assigns the remaining road officer to the main cliff-road turnoff; the narrow service footpath is a separate route below the wall.
clips.end_frame: Main cliff road marked as covered, Sơn acknowledging; service footpath remains a separate gap to watch.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Chặn đường chính lên tháp. Báo ngay nếu hắn đổi hướng.

clips.lighting: Same afternoon as scene 36, quiet shade behind awning.

cinematic.intent: Expose a specific spatial limitation so later escape feels like exploitation, not police forgetting a door.
cinematic.composition: Keep Mây and Sơn above the existing map, main road and thin service route both visible.
cinematic.blocking: She assigns the remaining officer to the main turnoff, leaving the lower footpath a distinct route to watch.
cinematic.performance: Her concentration includes the limitation; Sơn understands it without a reassuring nod that dismisses the risk.

scenes.title: Quá Khứ: Đôi Găng Đầu Tiên

cinematic.sound_detail: Rain remains outside the shelter, her invitation direct and unornamented beneath it.
cinematic.rhythm: Let him hesitate before accepting cover, giving the kindness a small real cost in trust.

cinematic.texture: Steam and ordinary ceramic stand against the dry silk-shop interior and his damp sleeves.

dramaturgy.turn_vi: Tô cơm thành công việc, đôi găng thành nghĩa vụ giữ cửa, Sơn hiện tại chọn cất chúng.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Bàn tay trắng của Sơn trẻ đối diện bàn tay có bằng chứng của anh hôm nay.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Ký ức làm việc từ chối Bà Hai ở cảng có giá tình cảm, không thêm một thông tin hồ sơ.

scenes.title: Bản Đồ Lúc Hoàng Hôn
scenes.purpose: Thiết lập một lần địa lý và vị trí lực lượng cho toàn cao trào.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Keep the two approaching engines into the arrivals. The next shot shows parking, not a repeated approach from the road.

cinematic.rhythm: Read the layout before concentrating on individuals, making later movement a consequence of this place.

clips.end_frame: Van and stretcher path clear, Mây heading back to the pier.

dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Tuyến xe cứu hộ và cửa kỹ thuật được ghi bằng không gian, không cần thuyết minh lần nữa.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Hạ có thể tự bước từ xe tới vạch an toàn hay vẫn chỉ là món hàng?

clips.start_frame: Small scarf fragment sealed between Mây and Hạ.

clips.end_frame: Hạ pointing to the torn edge without touching the seal.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Tao xé lúc bị đưa ra cửa.

clips.lighting: Later that night at station, neutral desk lamp and kettle, quiet dark windows.

cinematic.intent: Reframe the torn scarf as evidence of Hạ's own decision, not merely Sơn's keepsake.
cinematic.composition: Use the locked detail on the SHORT fragment sealed between the two women, her finger near the edge.
cinematic.blocking: She indicates the torn part through the sleeve without opening or touching the seal.
cinematic.performance: Her off-frame explanation is exact and composed, avoiding a dramatic reenactment of the abduction.
cinematic.focus: Keep sleeve, torn weave and pointing fingertip in one sensible plane, no impossible enlargement of fibres.
cinematic.texture: The small fragment remains distinct from the LONG scarf on the chair, with no new intact duplicate.
cinematic.sound_detail: A light sleeve rustle precedes her line, fan continues, no remembered captor voices or flashback effects.
cinematic.rhythm: Make the identification one clear beat; do not repeat the tearing action on screen after it has been explained.

clips.start_frame: Thành showing Hạ the saved video on a tablet.
clips.action: She identifies the ferry emblem and the meal-delivery rhythm she used to count days.
clips.end_frame: Thành adding the identifiable transport detail to the statement.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Còi tàu tới trước bữa tối. Ngày nào cũng vậy.

clips.lighting: Later that night at station, neutral desk lamp and kettle, quiet dark windows.

cinematic.intent: Confirm a lived detail that turns an earlier clue into usable testimony without pretending the audience just discovered it.
cinematic.composition: Frame Hạ and Thành with the saved video on the existing tablet between them.
cinematic.blocking: She points out the ferry emblem and habitual sound timing while Thành notes the specific transport detail.
cinematic.performance: Her certainty comes from repetition endured, not a clever-detective smile; Thành listens rather than finishing her words.
cinematic.focus: Keep her speaking face primary, tablet readable as a recorded image without requiring generated legible labels.
cinematic.texture: Clean clothes remain ordinary and the captured room is confined to the tablet, no extra Hạ body appears.
cinematic.sound_detail: Tablet audio may stay muted beneath her line, with only the actual station fan and pencil present.
cinematic.rhythm: Let recognition move quickly into the new factual detail, avoiding an extended replay of the entire video.

clips.start_frame: Hạ holding her own empty palms above the table.
clips.action: She describes deciding to keep the service hatch open when Kiên took her upward.
clips.end_frame: Mây listening without interrupting, Hạ's hands relaxing.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Tao chỉ cần họ vào được sau tao.

clips.lighting: Later that night at station, neutral desk lamp and kettle, quiet dark windows.

cinematic.intent: Give Hạ authorship of the door decision without glorifying the danger she survived.
cinematic.composition: Close on her face and relaxed empty hands at table height, Mây remains her off-axis listener.
cinematic.blocking: She opens her palms as she explains the single practical aim of keeping access available.
cinematic.performance: Her voice is controlled with a trace of fatigue; no triumphant claim or sudden collapse into staged tears.
cinematic.focus: Hold her eyes and nearest fingertips within natural depth, keeping focus on a person deciding what to tell.
cinematic.texture: No prop is added to demonstrate the latch, and the clean blouse does not acquire new damage.
cinematic.sound_detail: Only her line and a quiet breath break the fan bed, no hatch noises replayed from the tower.
cinematic.rhythm: Allow one pause before the reason, then let the hands settle; this is testimony, not another suspense set-piece.

clips.start_frame: Hair clip recovered from the hatch, now in its own sealed bag.
clips.action: Thành photographs Hạ identifying it and adds the recovery location.
clips.end_frame: Clip bag and station record together, chain of custody intact.
clips.lighting: Later that night at station, neutral desk lamp and kettle, quiet dark windows.

cinematic.intent: Anchor the rescue trace in a recoverable object and finish its evidentiary route.
cinematic.composition: Lock the detail on the SAME silver clip sealed separately beside the station record.
cinematic.blocking: Thành documents Hạ identifying the clip, leaving the sleeve closed and recovery note together.
cinematic.performance: Visible hands behave carefully and routinely; nobody holds the item aloft like a trophy.
cinematic.focus: Keep clip shape and the photographic record legible as forms, not readable generated text or a new device montage.
cinematic.texture: The clip is no longer in the hatch or Hạ's hair, sealed sleeve count stays fixed.
cinematic.sound_detail: A camera shutter and paper placement are small sounds, without electronic discovery chimes or another voice line.
cinematic.rhythm: One identification and record completes the chain; end ready to continue the interview rather than opening a new mystery.

clips.start_frame: Interview ended, Thành stopping the recorder in the background.
clips.action: Hạ asks to see her father's house the following morning instead of asking only about Sơn.
clips.end_frame: Mây placing the old family-house key on the table.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Mai đưa tao về nhà ba nhé.

clips.lighting: Later that night at station, neutral desk lamp and kettle, quiet dark windows.

cinematic.intent: Give Hạ a forward-looking request that belongs to her life beyond Sơn.
cinematic.composition: Medium coverage keeps Hạ and Mây at the interview table, Thành ending the record in the background.
cinematic.blocking: Mây puts the existing family-house key down within Hạ's reach after the statement ends.
cinematic.performance: Hạ asks simply, with relief mixed with uncertainty about entering an old home, not a declaration of endless waiting.
cinematic.focus: Keep key placement subordinate to Hạ's speaking face; no focus flourish turns it into a secret clue.
cinematic.texture: Scarf remains on the chair or with her, clean clothes and documented clip stay separate.
cinematic.sound_detail: Recorder stop and a light key contact frame her line, with kettle and fan continuing normally.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the official activity finish, then the personal request arrive; end on the offered key, not a new farewell.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Hạ sẽ được nhớ như con tin hay người đã quyết định để lại dấu?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Cô làm rõ dấu khăn, video và kẹp rồi chọn việc về nhà của mình.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Lời khai bắt đầu từ quyền được nghỉ của người sống sót.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Biến điều khán giả thấy thành sự thật điều tra, không diễn lại cảnh bị giữ.

scenes.title: Tên Của Những Cánh Cửa
scenes.purpose: Sơn nhận trách nhiệm cụ thể, không coi cứu Hạ là xóa tội.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Carry the station fan from the quiet holding room into morning evidence handover. Do not replay the statement or signature.

clips.start_frame: Recorder centered on the interview desk, Sơn seated on the other side.
clips.action: Mây checks he understands the interview and starts the recording.
clips.end_frame: Recorder light steady, Sơn facing Mây.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Anh muốn khai từ việc nào?

clips.lighting: Late-night interview room, one warm desk lamp, dim corridor outside.

cinematic.intent: Make Sơn initiate an account that can cost him, even after the rescue earned sympathy.
cinematic.composition: Frame him across the interview desk with recorder centered and Mây listening, distinct from Hạ's prior table.
cinematic.blocking: Mây confirms readiness and starts the recorder once, Sơn remains seated instead of performing a confession entrance.
cinematic.performance: He meets her eyes without the guarded half-smile of the opening, she remains professional and attentive.
cinematic.focus: Hold both faces in medium depth, keeping the recording light a modest factual indicator.
cinematic.texture: Black suit and LEFT bandage persist, closed watch stays secured in the pocket rather than being displayed.
cinematic.sound_detail: A single record-button click precedes Mây's question; the room is quieter than the public station.
cinematic.rhythm: Allow the question to create a genuine choice, then end with Sơn ready to answer, not already reenacting his past.

clips.action: Sơn names the first address and year, choosing facts instead of his nickname.
clips.end_frame: Mây writing an address in the private record, Sơn remaining seated.

dialogue.speaker: SON_S
dialogue.text: Địa chỉ đầu tiên. Tôi nhớ người mở cửa.

clips.lighting: Late-night interview room, one warm desk lamp, dim corridor outside.

cinematic.intent: Replace the nickname's mystique with a specific address and a remembered human consequence.
cinematic.composition: Continue the exact medium interview setup, paper and recorder remaining where the previous frame left them.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn names the first address and year while Mây writes, no imaginary door appears in this room.
cinematic.performance: He speaks plainly with effortful precision, avoiding a stylized killer's recital or dramatic stare into camera.
cinematic.focus: Maintain the existing focal plane and composition across the seam, allowing writing and listening without a new insert.
cinematic.texture: Paper remains private and unreadable to camera, pen and recorder are the same objects.
cinematic.sound_detail: Voice and pencil carry the beat, no rain or gunshot flashback soundtrack invading the testimony.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the factual words land before Mây's note finishes, and leave a small breathing space for what comes next.

clips.start_frame: Sơn looking at the paper rather than at his reflection in the window.
clips.action: He states that fear and debt do not excuse what he did.
clips.end_frame: His bare hands flat on the table, no watch used as a prop.

dialogue.speaker: SON_S
dialogue.text: Không ai bắt tay tôi làm. Tôi phải chịu.

clips.lighting: Late-night interview room, one warm desk lamp, dim corridor outside.

cinematic.intent: Keep responsibility from becoming another elegant line that excuses the speaker.
cinematic.composition: Close on Sơn reading the paper, his face angled away from the window reflection.
cinematic.blocking: He keeps bare hands flat instead of reaching for the closed watch or touching his scar.
cinematic.performance: The admission is uncomfortable and direct, with no self-pity smile and no demand that Mây forgive him.
cinematic.focus: Stay on eyes and the nearest resting hand, not an ornamental focus shift into the reflective glass.
cinematic.texture: LEFT bandage remains real, jacket creases remain, no symbolic prop or fresh injury is added.
cinematic.sound_detail: The line is dry in the quiet room, followed by a normal breath rather than a musical absolution cue.
cinematic.rhythm: Keep the sentence short, then let him remain answerable in the silence instead of concluding the whole interview.

clips.start_frame: Mây separating verified facts from items needing investigation.
clips.action: She asks for names of people who can confirm the account and records each answer.
clips.end_frame: Two evidence columns on paper without readable text, Sơn cooperating.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Ai còn sống để xác nhận chuyện này?

clips.lighting: Late-night interview room, one warm desk lamp, dim corridor outside.

cinematic.intent: Make the account lead outward to verification rather than stay inside Sơn's personal mythology.
cinematic.composition: Medium coverage includes Mây's two evidence columns, Sơn opposite and the existing recorder.
cinematic.blocking: Mây separates verified facts from new leads and asks for people who can confirm them.
cinematic.performance: She does not soften the question because he helped Hạ, Sơn listens without defending his reputation.
cinematic.focus: Keep her mouth and working hands readable together; columns are shapes, never a demand for readable document text.
cinematic.texture: The same paper and pen remain on the desk, no additional evidence suddenly arrives to validate him.
cinematic.sound_detail: A page turn and precise question continue the room tone, with no courtroom-like dramatic sound treatment.
cinematic.rhythm: The question should open the next necessary step quickly, preserving procedural momentum after the emotional admission.

clips.action: Sơn gives the next contact and signs the statement after reading it.
clips.end_frame: Statement signed, pen set aside once, hands withdrawn.
clips.lighting: Late-night interview room, one warm desk lamp, dim corridor outside.

cinematic.intent: Show commitment becoming a signed record rather than another promise to do better.
cinematic.composition: Continue the same medium framing, camera axis and paper position from Mây's verification question.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn supplies the next contact, reads the statement and signs once before setting the pen down.
cinematic.performance: His concentration is ordinary and sober; the small fatigue in the LEFT wrist remains without obstructing the signature.
cinematic.focus: Keep his RIGHT signing hand and face within the established field, no handwriting macro or heroic pen close-up.
cinematic.texture: One pen, one statement and the same bandage remain, no new dramatic document wording appears.
cinematic.sound_detail: Paper movement and one pen contact finish the exchange, no extra spoken line or recorder beep is improvised.
cinematic.rhythm: Allow the read before the signature, then the hand withdraws; do not repeat signing from another implied angle.

clips.start_frame: Sơn seated in the holding room after the interview, corridor light outside.
clips.action: He closes his eyes and rests with the wrist bandage visible, no new speech.
clips.end_frame: Sơn finally sleeping, closed watch secured in his pocket.
clips.lighting: Late-night interview room, one warm desk lamp, dim corridor outside.

cinematic.intent: Let rest follow accountability instead of treating unconsciousness as redemption.
cinematic.composition: Use a stable wide of the holding bench, barred window and corridor light beyond.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn settles carefully, closes his eyes once, and stops trying to manage what happens outside.
cinematic.performance: Exhaustion replaces vigilance gradually; no smile implies that his consequences have vanished.
cinematic.focus: Keep the room's ordinary proportions and his resting body readable, avoiding a prison-martyr close-up.
cinematic.texture: LEFT bandage and black suit remain, the one CLOSED watch is secured in his pocket and never opened again.
cinematic.sound_detail: Ceiling fan, distant corridor steps and breathing replace dialogue, with no separate sad music track.
cinematic.rhythm: Let posture soften during the take, then cut from living rest rather than holding a frozen final tableau.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Sơn có nói hết cả phần không giúp anh được tha thứ?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Anh gọi tên địa chỉ và người xác nhận, ký vào trách nhiệm riêng.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Không còn bí danh che giữa người khai và hành vi đã làm.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Cứu Hạ không xóa tội; không thêm cảnh bạo lực minh họa lời khai.

scenes.title: Sổ Tiền Thành Hồ Sơ
scenes.purpose: Bằng chứng được xác minh và đời sống thị trấn bắt đầu trở lại.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Keep ordinary town morning sound from the walk to the family-house threshold. Market-stall planning happens after the home entry.

clips.start_frame: Investigator reviewing the sealed originals against Thành's handover record.
clips.action: Mây delivers the remaining local witness files for the same case.
clips.end_frame: Complete evidence handover recorded, local copies retained.

dialogue.speaker: RADIO
dialogue.text: Đã khớp sổ với xưởng và chuyến tàu.

clips.lighting: Day-eight morning, ordinary coastal daylight and neutral interiors, no action lighting.

cinematic.intent: Resolve the evidence route with verification, not a celebratory broadcast that retells the plot.
cinematic.composition: The wide connects investigator, originals, handover record and Mây's remaining witness files.
cinematic.blocking: She delivers the local files while the existing record is checked against the sealed originals.
cinematic.performance: People work with relief but no applause, treating the case as continuing responsibility beyond one dramatic night.
cinematic.focus: Keep the relationship of original sleeves and local copies readable without trying to show legible account figures.
cinematic.texture: Black and red books remain distinct, original USB and token do not merge into one object.
cinematic.sound_detail: One concise radio confirmation sits over paper and station fan, not a news theme or public cheer.
cinematic.rhythm: Move directly through the final handover, ending complete but not framing it as another emotional end of the film.

clips.start_frame: Bảy returning an overturned chair to its regular place, Thành nearby.
clips.action: They reopen the stall together, without retelling the whole fight.
clips.end_frame: Chair upright, first clean glass on the counter.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Giờ bán cà phê lại được chưa?

clips.lighting: Day-eight morning, ordinary coastal daylight and neutral interiors, no action lighting.

cinematic.intent: Return the town to an ordinary transaction rather than another retelling of the fight.
cinematic.composition: Frame Bảy and Thành at the coffee counter with the familiar chair and first clean glass.
cinematic.blocking: They restore the chair and open the stall, keeping the work small and habitual.
cinematic.performance: Bảy's question contains weary practical humour, Thành's response can stay in a look rather than extra dialogue.
cinematic.focus: Keep both at conversational medium depth, without isolating the chair like a sacred relic.
cinematic.texture: Counter, chair and glass are the same worn everyday items, no new flowers or hero portrait appears.
cinematic.sound_detail: Chair feet on concrete and a glass placed normally create a lighter rhythm after the interview quiet.
cinematic.rhythm: Let work proceed through the line, finishing ready to serve instead of pausing for laughter or a curtain-call reaction.

clips.start_frame: Mây walking through the reopening fish market.
clips.action: She checks on sellers who evacuated and thanks them for keeping the routes clear.
clips.end_frame: Mây with two unnamed sellers at the repaired side gate.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Cảm ơn mọi người đã đưa dân ra.

clips.lighting: Day-eight morning, ordinary coastal daylight and neutral interiors, no action lighting.

cinematic.intent: Show communal repair through checking people, not praising Sơn as the town's saviour.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide along the reopened market lane, Mây meeting the two existing unnamed sellers near the gate.
cinematic.blocking: She checks the cleared passage and thanks the sellers while they resume normal handling of their stalls.
cinematic.performance: Her gratitude is sincere but brief; the sellers remain workers with lives rather than a cheering audience.
cinematic.focus: Keep the route and activity readable in ordinary depth, no spotlight isolating Mây in the crowd.
cinematic.texture: Gate stays repaired in its existing place, carts and tubs return to functional positions rather than fight poses.
cinematic.sound_detail: Market voices and normal water sounds resume beneath her thanks, replacing the night command bed.
cinematic.rhythm: Walk and conversation should carry forward together, ending as the sellers get back to business.

clips.start_frame: Linh at the clinic sink after filing his medical notes.
clips.action: He hangs the emptied response bag to dry and sits down at last.
clips.end_frame: Bag drying above the bench, Linh resting with a cup of water.
clips.lighting: Day-eight morning, ordinary coastal daylight and neutral interiors, no action lighting.

cinematic.intent: Let Linh's private fatigue provide a human consequence without restarting the medical suspense.
cinematic.composition: Frame the clinic sink, bag hook and bench medium, Linh already finished with his notes.
cinematic.blocking: He hangs the emptied response bag to dry and finally sits with water within reach.
cinematic.performance: A small release in his shoulders is enough, no collapse, tremor or haunted stare to camera.
cinematic.focus: Keep bag placement and seated figure in one composition, avoiding another medical-object montage.
cinematic.texture: Bag is the same used at the van, now emptied; no timer, amber antidote or new blood-stained item appears.
cinematic.sound_detail: Water at the sink settles into ventilation and a quiet cup contact, with no dialogue or lingering emergency tone.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the practical task complete first, then allow one ordinary breath of rest before moving on.

clips.start_frame: Thành wearing replacement glasses, Mây at the case board.
clips.action: They remove the emergency duty roster and restore the normal shift plan.
clips.end_frame: Emergency roster filed away, ordinary patrol map visible.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Đêm nay trực lại như cũ hả chị?

clips.lighting: Day-eight morning, ordinary coastal daylight and neutral interiors, no action lighting.

cinematic.intent: Use the return of a normal shift to show the emergency has ended without claiming the case is over.
cinematic.composition: Frame Thành and Mây at the ordinary patrol map with the temporary roster in hand.
cinematic.blocking: They remove and file the emergency assignment, restoring the regular map rather than erasing evidence.
cinematic.performance: Thành's question is half relief, half readiness to work; Mây need not answer with a moral speech.
cinematic.focus: Keep his replacement glasses and the map relation readable at medium distance, no generated text close-up.
cinematic.texture: New intact glasses appear here after the taped pair, paper roster stays one distinct sheet.
cinematic.sound_detail: Paper filing and ordinary station sounds sit below the short line, no radio alarm interrupts the calm.
cinematic.rhythm: Keep this a brisk administrative beat, not a new round of farewells for every supporting character.

clips.start_frame: Hạ at the station doorway with the family-house key, Mây joining her empty-handed.
clips.action: They walk toward the harbour houses instead of the crime-scene pier.
clips.end_frame: Both walking side by side in morning light.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Về nhà trước. Chuyện khác tính sau.

clips.lighting: Day-eight morning, ordinary coastal daylight and neutral interiors, no action lighting.

cinematic.intent: Carry Hạ toward her own home so recovery becomes action rather than a waiting-room image.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide at the station doorway, Hạ holding the family key and Mây joining empty-handed.
cinematic.blocking: They start toward the harbour houses together, leaving the crime-scene direction behind.
cinematic.performance: Hạ's apprehension is quiet and forward-facing, Mây's familiarity offers company without taking over.
cinematic.focus: Keep their shared direction clear, not alternating isolated reaction shots that stall the walk.
cinematic.texture: White blouse, jeans and long scarf remain the same, key stays with Hạ after the interview handover.
cinematic.sound_detail: Ordinary morning street sound replaces case-room fan, Mây's line light enough to belong to friends.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the invitation become actual walking immediately, ending in motion toward the next threshold.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Thị trấn sẽ trở lại nhịp sống thường bằng những việc gì?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Hồ sơ chuyển giao xong, ghế quán dựng lại, người trực trở về lịch bình thường.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Một chiếc ghế và chiếc kính mới thay lời ca ngợi người hùng.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Đây là nối việc trở lại, nhịp gọn chứ không một đoạn kết bi tráng nữa.

scenes.title: Chỗ Của Hạ
scenes.purpose: Hạ có mục tiêu đời sống riêng và bắt đầu thực hiện.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Keep the approaching transport engine into Sơn window-side view. Hạ already holds the single lily; do not wrap it again.

clips.start_frame: Hạ and Mây at the family-house doorstep, key in Hạ's right hand.
clips.action: Hạ unlocks her father's house, Mây remains outside until invited.
clips.end_frame: Door open, Hạ inside her own threshold.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Vào đi. Nhà tao mà.

clips.lighting: Same day-eight morning, soft house daylight, bright public walkway.

cinematic.intent: Let Hạ claim the right to invite someone into her own space again.
cinematic.composition: Frame the old house threshold wide, key in her RIGHT hand and Mây remaining outside.
cinematic.blocking: Hạ opens the existing lock once and crosses first, then invites Mây rather than being led inside.
cinematic.performance: The line has a small reclaiming humour through fatigue, not a declaration that all trauma is gone.
cinematic.focus: Keep opening door and Hạ's first step readable with Mây's respectful pause in the same field.
cinematic.texture: Key remains the one from the station, no new house furnishing or welcoming relative appears.
cinematic.sound_detail: A normal key turn and door hinge sit under her invitation, with harbour morning sounds beyond.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the threshold change ownership emotionally in one entry, no second door-opening shot afterward.

clips.start_frame: Hạ before an old workbench with a lighthouse photograph.
clips.action: She wipes a clear space and sets her own bag down, claiming the room.
clips.end_frame: Clean patch on the workbench, her bag beside it.
clips.lighting: Same day-eight morning, soft house daylight, bright public walkway.

cinematic.intent: Make inhabiting the house a concrete first task, not another memorial scene.
cinematic.composition: Use medium framing around the existing workbench and lighthouse photograph with Hạ alone.
cinematic.blocking: She wipes one useful space and sets her own bag down there, leaving the rest unfinished.
cinematic.performance: Her attention is practical, a brief look at the photograph can inform the work without becoming a grief performance.
cinematic.focus: Keep cleared patch and face naturally visible, avoiding a shrine-like focus pull to the photograph.
cinematic.texture: Dust stays where she has not wiped, ordinary bag and worn bench remain materially specific.
cinematic.sound_detail: Cloth against wood and the bag settling are enough, no remembered father voice or music cue.
cinematic.rhythm: Complete the modest clearing, then finish on a usable space rather than trying to tidy the whole house in ten seconds.

clips.start_frame: Empty strip beside the fish-market entrance, no finished flower stall yet.
clips.action: Hạ measures a modest place for a folding table, Mây holds the tape end.
clips.end_frame: Space marked with chalk, both facing the future stall position.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Tao mở ở đây. Sáng người ta đi qua đông.

clips.lighting: Same day-eight morning, soft house daylight, bright public walkway.

cinematic.intent: Translate Hạ's earlier wish into a choice of dimensions and a workable place.
cinematic.composition: The wide shows the empty market strip, both ends of the tape and existing entrance traffic beyond.
cinematic.blocking: Hạ measures while Mây holds the other end, keeping the future stall modest and absent from the present image.
cinematic.performance: Hạ is engaged in making something viable, Mây listens as a friend instead of an approving official.
cinematic.focus: Keep marked ground and the two people's roles legible in depth, not a premature finished-shop fantasy.
cinematic.texture: Chalk mark, tape and bare space remain ordinary; no flower display materializes before construction.
cinematic.sound_detail: Tape extending and morning market chatter support the line, with no triumph fanfare.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the measure reach its chosen edge during speech, then end on an actual decision about the space.

clips.start_frame: Hạ at the chalk mark, Mây holding the other end of the tape.
clips.action: Mây asks whether Hạ wants to wait until the case ends, Hạ keeps measuring.
clips.end_frame: Tape extended to the agreed edge, Hạ making her own decision.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Tao mở cho tao sống trước đã.

clips.lighting: Same day-eight morning, soft house daylight, bright public walkway.

cinematic.intent: Make Hạ's independence a working decision rather than an inspirational slogan delivered to camera.
cinematic.composition: Medium coverage keeps her at the chalk mark, Mây holding the same tape end.
cinematic.blocking: She keeps measuring while answering the question about waiting, without dropping the practical task for a speech.
cinematic.performance: The answer is plain and certain, with a trace of humour toward her friend, not defiance aimed at Sơn.
cinematic.focus: Keep her face and tape hand within one setup, allowing Mây's listening reaction without a new cut.
cinematic.texture: Tape stays at the same edge and grey-to-white wardrobe change is already complete, no new symbolic prop appears.
cinematic.sound_detail: Tape movement and normal market bed continue under the short line, making it part of a real conversation.
cinematic.rhythm: Speak within work, then mark the agreed edge; finish with the project advancing rather than holding for applause.

clips.start_frame: One white lily from her father's small yard vase on the windowsill.
clips.action: Hạ trims the stem and wraps only this flower in plain paper.
clips.end_frame: Single wrapped lily in Hạ's hand, remaining vase undisturbed.
clips.lighting: Same day-eight morning, soft house daylight, bright public walkway.

cinematic.intent: Choose one personal farewell object without restarting the whole flower-shop romance.

cinematic.blocking: She trims and wraps only that stem, leaving the remaining vase untouched.
cinematic.performance: Hands move with a florist's everyday familiarity, not as if preparing a funeral offering.
cinematic.focus: Keep stem, paper and fingers within a plausible detail plane, no new written message needs to be legible.
cinematic.texture: Plain paper, natural petal imperfections and the same window light make the flower ordinary and specific.
cinematic.sound_detail: Paper folds and a quiet stem contact replace dialogue, with home breeze and harbour sounds still present.

clips.start_frame: Hạ and Mây reaching the public walkway, transport engine heard near the station.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Hạ có bắt đầu sống trước khi biết bao giờ Sơn trở lại?

scenes.title: Qua Ô Cửa Xe

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Hai người có thể chia tay mà không cần lời hứa dễ dàng?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Một bông hoa, một cái gật; Hạ quay về công việc, Sơn đi tiếp bằng tên mình.

scenes.title: Căn Nhà Còn Mở Cửa

cinematic.blocking: She documents the wood once, lowers the phone and leaves the marks unaltered.
cinematic.performance: Her hands are professional and gentle, not hovering over a potential eighth cut or secret message.
cinematic.focus: Keep tally depth and phone relation clear, avoiding readable screen text or a second overlapping photograph.
cinematic.texture: Seven marks remain seven, no knife, hair clip or new scratched row is introduced.

cinematic.sound_detail: Table legs touch wood with a modest knock, porch wind and daytime voices keep the work alive.

dialogue.text: Nhà này gió. Làm chân bàn chắc vào.

cinematic.texture: Worn hinges and an unpainted leg keep the table plausible, bucket stays empty and unique.
cinematic.sound_detail: Leg hinges, a light wobble and bucket contact supply gentle rhythm under the line.
cinematic.rhythm: One unfold and one balance check complete the beat; do not repeat the wobble just to fill the take.

cinematic.blocking: Mây passes the documented strip only when Hạ asks to keep it beneath the counter.
cinematic.performance: Hạ's line is matter-of-fact remembrance, not a promise to count years until Sơn returns.
cinematic.focus: Keep wood strip and faces readable, avoiding a glamour close-up that turns the marks into a supernatural token.
cinematic.texture: Old seven-mark strip is distinct from the new doorframe, repair occurs this afternoon consistently with the earlier line.
cinematic.sound_detail: Old wood touching her hands and work sounds beyond the line retain a practical environment.
cinematic.rhythm: Complete one transfer, then let their attention return toward fitting the table rather than dwelling on an absent man.

cinematic.blocking: They sand and fit the already established legs, brushing dust away until the table stands straight.
cinematic.performance: Concentration and small cooperative adjustments replace dialogue, no one stops to look toward the road for Sơn.

cinematic.texture: Natural sawdust and moving pine shadows retain texture, seven-mark strip is kept for underside use, not re-scratched.
cinematic.sound_detail: Soft sanding and wood contact continue as a real work bed, no sentimental reprise required.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the surface become ready through steady activity, ending on the object that can match the finished counter years later.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Người trở lại có thể bước vào đời sống Hạ đã tự xây?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Hạ nhận ra một bàn tay trần và mở chỗ ngồi bình thường.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Sạp hoa đang sống tốt trước tiếng xe đò tới.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Trả tư thế nhìn biển và chuyến xe đầu; không đồng hồ thứ hai hay phản diện mới.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Bảy nhắc cái xô hôm qua, trong khi Sơn giúp nhặt thùng ngay sáng ngày 1 ở 01.2.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Đổi thoại đúng vật và đúng ngày, giữ sự biết ơn làm nền bảo vệ Sơn.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Sơn đeo găng nhưng nói bị gài để dấu tay; chi tiết này làm cơ chế bẫy yếu đi.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Cho anh nhận ra bị ép nhận gói chứng cứ, không khẳng định dấu vân tay khi đang mang găng.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Khung đầu cửa đã hé nhưng hành động lại dùng chìa để vào.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Khởi đầu cửa còn khép, chìa cũ mở đúng cửa đó trong cùng cú tracking.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Mây nhìn được vật đã giấu kín trên xà như thể nhìn xuyên gỗ.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Cô chỉ thấy mép bao ở khe xà và ghi vị trí nghi vấn, không kết luận đầy đủ từ xa.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Câu mở hiện tại có cảm xúc nhưng câu hỏi nguy cơ còn nhẹ.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Làm chậm khoảnh khắc quyết định ở lại: Sơn chờ xe đi khuất rồi mới chuyển trọng lượng về phía thị trấn, không tạo thêm kẻ theo dõi giả.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Sơn hiện trong cận cảnh nhưng câu nói được đánh mode off, dễ khiến model giữ miệng đứng khi anh nói.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Đổi sang nói trong hình, bước lùi nhỏ trong tầm cửa sổ để miệng vẫn thấy rõ.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Lời người bị đưa đi khẳng định quá sớm trước lúc mở dữ liệu khóa ở25 và xác nhận Hạ trong lịch chuyển.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Chỉ chốt ngày tàu rời và nhu cầu mở phần khóa, để25 còn giá trị phát hiện mới.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Bộ vest còn nằm trên đùi ở21.2 nhưng21.3 đóng túi mà chưa trả quần áo vào, dễ làm mất vật giữa cú máy nối.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Trả bộ vest và găng gấp sẵn vào túi trước khi đóng, giữ nguyên điểm đầu và cuối.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Cú C nối trực tiếp từ gương mặt Sơn ở23.2 nhưng câu của Bà Hai lại yêu cầu khẩu hình trong hình.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Giữ máy trên người nghe, đổi giọng Bà Hai sang ngoài khung; sức nặng nằm ở Sơn tiếp nhận câu bán Hạ.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Ý đồ cảnh nói Thành bảo vệ dân, nhưng hành động đang chỉ cho thấy cậu nhìn cửa sau khi đã bị trói.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Cho tư thế ngồi bị giữ của Thành thực sự che hướng nhìn của Dũng, bảo vệ lối thoát mà không thêm đánh nhau.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Một đồng hồ đếm xuất hiện để bị gạt đi dù kế hiện tại không còn mẹo38/40 phút, tạo cảm giác đang giải thích lại bản cũ.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Bỏ đạo cụ timer, gạch một ước lượng hồi phục trên bản phác kế hoạch đã có để Linh bác sự chắc chắn bằng hành động nhỏ.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Điểm đầu đã bày toàn bộ sổ và phần cứng trên bàn nhưng hành động lại mang chúng tới thêm lần nữa; quá nhiều thao tác trong10 giây.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Đầu clip phân nhóm đồ ở túi Mây và cạnh Sơn, chỉ thực hiện một lần gom-niêm phong các bản gốc.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Đỗ xe, dỡ thùng và lắp cả chỗ cứu hộ trong một clip10 giây dễ sinh montage hoặc tua vội.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Bắt đầu khi xe đã đỗ và phần lớn chuẩn bị đã xong, chỉ dỡ thùng cuối và cố định nệm, giữ nguyên điểm kết.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Đòi ký nhận tội còn chung chung và dễ bị hiểu là chữ ký sẽ làm biến mất chứng cứ độc lập đã gửi điều tra.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Làm rõ Kiên muốn biến Sơn và Bà Hai thành người nhận hết trách nhiệm, qua một câu ngắn có ý riêng của phản diện.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: CameraC đang cần đọc mặt Hạ và bàn tay giữ cánh tay nhưng điểm cuối lại yêu cầu thấy hướng bàn chân, dễ ép máy tự cắt hoặc tilt.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Giữ close-up, chuyển thử đường thoát sang đổi trọng tâm nhẹ hiện lên vai và ánh nhìn; Kiên tay PHẢI giữ bắp tay TRÁI Hạ, tay trái chưa lộ.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Hạ ở phía tây cạnh xe trắng còn phong bì ở đường ghép giữa sân; cú đá chưa có khoảng cách khả thi.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Bỏ đá phong bì. Hạ ghì chân chống kéo về xe, giữ quyền chủ động mà không dịch chuyển về giữa sân. Cập nhật đầu43.1 và âm nối42 cùng lúc.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Đầu cảnh đang kế thừa phong bì đã bị đá dù cú đá42.6 không khả thi.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Giữ phong bì ở vị trí đặt tại41.4, không đổi thế đứng nhân vật.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Âm nối hiện nói phong bì trượt tới vạch an toàn, phụ thuộc cú đá bị bỏ.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Giữ âm máy xe và biển, lệnh công an chỉ xuất hiện43.3.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Mây nói Hạ đang tự giữ đường trước khi tổ phụ phát hiện kẹp ở48.5; cô biết điều chưa được báo.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Lời Mây chỉ dựa trên tình trạng đội tiếp cận đã biết, vẫn động viên Sơn.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Súng từ tay Kiên50.2 tới sàn51.4 thiếu hành động mất kiểm soát, trong khi Sơn chỉ chặn một cánh tay không xác định.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Khóa súng tay TRÁI Kiên, tay PHẢI vừa buông Hạ. Súng rơi vào trong trước cú cứu, không thêm kỹ thuật tước súng chi tiết.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Một người vừa tỉnh, tay trái băng có thể bị dựng thành nâng cả người đang treo ngoài biển; súng cũng dễ xuất hiện lại trên tay.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Kiên chưa ra khỏi lan can. Sơn chỉ kéo trọng tâm vào khi chân vẫn phía trong; súng nằm nguyên trong sân.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Mây lại mang chìa nhà dù54.6 đã đưa Hạ và57.1 chìa trong tay Hạ.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Hạ giữ chìa liên tục từ bàn lời khai tới nhà.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Bảy nói mai sửa cửa, nhưng59.5 đã có khung cũ tháo và khung mới trong cùng chiều ngày8.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Sửa lời thành làm ngay chiều nay để không cần thêm ngày hoặc cảnh sửa lặp.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Kiên không thể xoay bánh cửa khi tay trái cầm súng và tay phải liên tục giữ Hạ.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Cho hắn tạm bỏ tay phải khỏi cánh tay Hạ để mở cửa, thân vẫn chắn đường xuống. Hạ không chạy thoát mà dùng khoảng rảnh này cho kẹp.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Cú đẩy cửa cần xác định tay phải Kiên đang rảnh sau khi mở bánh cửa.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Giữ tay trái cầm súng thấp, tay phải đẩy cửa, Hạ dùng tay phải đặt kẹp.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Kiên thử chốt phía sau rồi kéo Hạ lên nhưng tay giữ người/súng chưa chuyển trạng thái rõ.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Tay phải thử chốt, sau đó mới nắm lại tay trái Hạ để đi tiếp; súng ở tay trái suốt.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Cuối clip kẹp vẫn ở chốt nhưng hướng dẫn nói đã thu hồi48.5 và54.5 có túi niêm phong.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Tổ phụ giữ cửa, Thành lấy kẹp sau khi qua khe; không thêm túi hay dụng cụ mới trong shot.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Tờ nhận tội Kiên để ở36.5 đã được Mây giữ37.1/37.6; tới41.1 lại có một tập trắng vật lý thứ hai.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Để Kiên đổi điều kiện bằng lời, không đưa thêm tập giấy. Tay phải giữ tay trái Hạ, tay trái vẫn che kín trước lúc súng được thấy44.3.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Đầu clip còn mô tả Sơn giữa tập nhận tội và vạch an toàn dù tập giấy đã ở Mây.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Chỉ giữ Sơn, vạch an toàn và phong bì bản sao anh đang mang, hành động đặt phong bì không đổi.

reviewed_changes.problem_vi: Lời mở còn thiên về phong cảnh, chưa cho người xem lý do theo cuộc tìm kiếm.
reviewed_changes.fix_vi: Đổi lời dẫn thành nhu cầu tìm dấu Hạ trước khi quá muộn, không khẳng định cô còn sống.

directing_detail_policy: Each clip has eight scene-specific directing fields. Core action, current appearances, object ownership and start/end contract govern interpretation. Details never add extra dialogue or an internal cut.
